scripts.text: Bomi is gathering her thoughts. I should talk to her later.
scripts.translation: 波米正在整理思绪。我应该稍后再和她谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
So he ^0000cdpromised^000000. Then one day, some people came here looking for him, and they fought.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
于是他^0000cd承诺^000000了。然后有一天，一些人来到这里寻找他，他们打了起来。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
And the next thing I knew, I was turned. Dracula broke his promise.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
等我回过神来，我已经变成了吸血鬼。德古拉违背了他的承诺。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I couldn't believe he turned me into a monster. I trusted him!
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我无法相信他把我变成了魔物。我那么信任他！

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
People in the outside world must think I skipped town. How long has it been since I left?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
外面的人一定以为我逃走了。我离开多久了？

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Sigh, maybe they all forgot about me, as if I never existed. That's what pains me the most.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
唉，也许他们都忘了我，仿佛我从未存在过。这才是最让我痛苦的。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I try to ignore my reality, but this ever-present hunger and thirst keep reminding me what kind of terrible monster I am.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我试图忽视现实，但这挥之不去的饥渴不断提醒我，我究竟是多么可怕的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
If I go back to the outside world, I won't be able to stop myself from hurting people.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
如果我回到外面的世界，我无法阻止自己伤害别人。

scripts.text: How did you sustain yourself so far?
scripts.translation: 你是怎么维持至今的？

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I studied ^0000cdpharmaceutical formulation^000000 to make up for my weak stamina with potions.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我研究了^0000cd药剂调配^000000，用药水来弥补我虚弱的体力。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I drink fake blood that I make with the ingredients I can find here. I may look ^0000cdhuman enough^000000, but I'm not. Not really.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我喝着用这里能找到的材料制作的假血。我看起来可能^0000cd足够像人类^000000，但我不是。真的不是。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I'm sorry I bored you with my story.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
抱歉，我的故事让你感到无聊了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not at all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一点也不。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Adventurer, I don't want to impose on your kindness, but may I ask you a favor?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
冒险者，我不想打扰你的善意，但我可以请你帮个忙吗？

scripts.text: Sure, anything for you.
scripts.translation: 当然，为你效劳。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
You shouldn't say that. What if I ask for your blood?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
你不该这么说。万一我向你索要血液呢？

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I was joking. I'm in the middle of collecting the fake blood ingredients, but right now I want to examine this mushroom. I've never seen it before. I want to check it while it's still fresh.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我在开玩笑。我正在收集假血的材料，但现在我想检查一下这个蘑菇。我从没见过它。我想趁它还新鲜时看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What kinds of ingredients do you need? I'll get them for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你需要什么材料？我去帮你弄来。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Thank you. I need ^0000cd10 Sticky Bloods from Matte Drainliars and 10 Mushroom Saps from Neon Mushrooms^000000. Thank you for doing this for me.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
谢谢。我需要^0000cd10个来自红蝙蝠的粘稠毒血和10个来自霓虹蘑菇的蘑菇汁^000000。谢谢你为我做这些。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here, I brought the things you asked.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
给你，我带来了你要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[波米]
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
This isn't enough.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
这不够。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Thank you. I need ^0000cd10 Sticky Bloods from Matte Drainliars and 10 Mushroom Saps from Neon Mushrooms^000000. Thank you for doing this for me.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
谢谢。我需要^0000cd10个来自红蝙蝠的粘稠毒血和10个来自霓虹蘑菇的蘑菇汁^000000。谢谢你为我做这些。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How's the mushroom?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
蘑菇怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
It turned out to be an ordinary, invaluable mushroom.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
结果发现是一种普通但无价的蘑菇。

scripts.text: How do you make artificial blood?
scripts.translation: 如何制作人造血液？

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Matte Drainliars feed on the blood of the reanimated corpses in this place.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
这里的 Matte 红蝙蝠以复活的尸体血液为食。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Did you get it? But their blood is highly toxic. So I use these mushrooms to detoxify it.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
你明白了吗？但它们的血液毒性极强。所以我用这些蘑菇来解毒。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Like this!
scripts.translation:
[波米]
就像这样！

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
But even their sap cannot completely remove the toxins in the blood. And when I ingest too much toxins...
scripts.translation:
[波米]
但即使它们的汁液也无法完全清除血液中的毒素。当我摄入过多毒素时...

scripts.text: Maybe you should've chosen a different career path.
scripts.translation: 也许你应该选择另一条职业道路。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Like alchemist, for example.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
比如炼金术士。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I didn't know I was talented at this. If I had ^0000cdenough time to live^000000, I would've had many different experiences. I might have chosen a different path.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我没想到自己在这方面很有天赋。如果我有^0000cd足够的时间活着^000000，我会经历许多不同的事情。我可能会选择不同的道路。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Oh, by the way, weren't you looking for someone? What did you say his name was? Juju?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
哦，对了，你之前在找谁来着？叫什么名字？Juju？

scripts.text: Jojo.
scripts.translation: 乔乔。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I haven't seen any other humans around here, but if I do, I'll let him know you're looking for him.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我还没看到附近有其他人类，但如果我见到了，我会告诉他你在找他。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I hope you'll find him soon. I'm not the only one here, you know. If you haven't found him, maybe he's?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
希望你能尽快找到他。这里不止我一个人。如果你还没找到他，也许他在...

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Never mind. Good luck finding him. Maybe you should check the catacombs in the south.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
算了。祝你好运。也许你应该去南边的地下墓穴看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you. I'll see you.

[Bomi]
You'd better hurry.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
你最好快点。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I hope you'll find your friend soon. Why don't you check the catacombs in the south? He might be there.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
希望你能尽快找到你的朋友。为什么不去南边的地下墓穴看看呢？他可能在那里。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Stay away from me, and I won't hurt you.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
离我远点，我就不会伤害你。

scripts.text:
[Marina]
One of us is missing. You hurt him, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
我们少了一个人。是你伤了他，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I've never hurt anyone, and I won't start now.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我从未伤害过任何人，现在也不会开始。

scripts.text:
[Marina]
Even if you won't, we're not going to let you go! Your existence in itself goes against His will!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
即使你不想，我们也不会放你走！你的存在本身就违背了祂的意志！

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
His will? God loves us all. Isn't that what you preach?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
祂的意志？上帝爱我们所有人。这不是你们一直传教的吗？

scripts.text:
[Marina]
The dead belong in the ground, and you're one of them. What do you think you are?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
死者应当归于尘土，而你正是其中之一。你以为你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
...But... But I really didn't hurt anyone.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
...但是...我真的没有伤害任何人。

scripts.text:
[Marina]
That doesn't guarantee you won't in the future.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
这并不能保证你未来不会伤害别人。

scripts.text:
[Gem]
Wait, Sister Marina. Calm yourself.
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
等等，玛丽娜修女。请冷静一下。

scripts.text:
[Marina]
Why aren't we getting rid of her already? The dead shall return to the earth! Brother Antoine!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
为什么我们还不除掉她？死者应当回归大地！安托万兄弟！

scripts.text:
[King]
Argh, I can't believe you threw yourself in the middle of that! This is why I can't leave you alone!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
啊，真不敢相信你竟然冲到了中间！这就是为什么我不能让你一个人待着！

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
...Dracula? Why?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
...德古拉？为什么？

scripts.text:
[Marina]
There's another vampire! No wonder why this place felt so off it's filled with vampires!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
还有一个吸血鬼！难怪这里感觉不对劲，这里充满了吸血鬼！

scripts.text:
[King]
Human, did you just call me a bat? How dare you?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
人类，你刚才叫我蝙蝠？你竟敢如此无礼？

scripts.text:
[Gem]
Wait, Sister Marina. I said, calm yourself.
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
等等，玛丽娜修女。我说了，请冷静。

scripts.text:
[Marina]
We have to act now. We've already incapacitated one out of the three.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
我们必须立刻行动。我们已经制服了三个中的一个。

scripts.text:
[Gem]
But one of them doesn't want to fight. She wants to talk.
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
但其中一个不想打架。她想谈谈。

scripts.text:
[King]
Who wants to talk? Because I don't! I'm not going to go down without a fight!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
谁想谈？我可不想！我不会不战而退的！

scripts.text:
[Marina]
Grr, let me go! Enough is enough!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
该死，放开我！够了！

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Oh geez, how do you move so fast?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
天哪，你们怎么动得这么快？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Everyone, calm the hell down!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
大家，都给我冷静点！

scripts.text:
[Gem]
Brother Jojo! You're safe!
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
乔乔兄弟！你没事吧！

scripts.text:
[Marina]
Where were you? We couldn't find you, and we looked everywhere!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
你刚才去哪了？我们到处找你，却怎么也找不到！

scripts.text:
[Antoine]
It's true. His wounds are almost fully healed.
scripts.translation:
[安托万]
确实如此。他的伤几乎完全愈合了。

scripts.text:
[Dracula]
Don't touch Bomi... She... I... We don't want to hurt anyone... She's taught me that...
scripts.translation:
[德古拉]
别碰波米...她...我...我们不想伤害任何人...是她教会我的...

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Dracula! Dracula! Let me heal you!
scripts.translation:
[波米]
德古拉！德古拉！让我为你治疗！

scripts.text:
[Marina]
I'm not going to let you do that!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
我不会让你这么做的！

scripts.text:
[Gem]
Leave them be. They saved Jojo.
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
随他们去吧。他们救了乔乔。

scripts.text:
[Marina]
But they could be using him as bait!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
但他们可能只是在利用他当诱饵！

scripts.text:
[Gem]
Even if they try to attack us, there are more of us than them.
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
即使他们想攻击我们，我们的人也比他们多。

scripts.text:
[Antoine]
I agree with Sister Gem. Also, it's not an everyday opportunity that we can see vampires from this close.
scripts.translation:
[安托万]
我同意杰姆修女的意见。而且，能这么近距离看到吸血鬼，可是千载难逢的机会。

scripts.text:
[Gem]
You're Bomi, right? I read your notebook. What happened? What did these vampires do to you?
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
你是波米，对吧？我看过你的笔记本。发生了什么事？这些吸血鬼对你做了什么？

scripts.text: I can explain.
scripts.translation: 我可以解释。

scripts.text: I relayed Bomi and Dracula's story to Nun Gem and the others.
scripts.translation: 我向杰姆修女和其他人转述了波米和德古拉的故事。

scripts.text:
[Gem]
So you're saying they really are innocent.
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
所以你是说，他们真的是无辜的。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Dracula, hang on. Drink this.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
德古拉，坚持住。喝下这个。

scripts.text:
[Marina]
Whose blood is that? You can't let him drink that!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
那是谁的血？你不能让他喝那个！

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
It's not real blood! He needs it! Can't you see he's dying?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
那不是真正的血！他需要它！你难道看不出他快死了吗？

scripts.text:
[Marina]
You're dead already!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
你已经是死人了！

scripts.text:
[King]
Gosh, you're so stubborn. Feed him. I'll keep them at bay.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
天哪，你真是固执。喂他吧。我会挡住他们。

scripts.text:
[Marina]
You're letting her feed him, that vampire? Sister Gem, have you forgotten your duty as our leader?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
你竟然让她给那个吸血鬼喂食？杰姆修女，你忘了你作为我们首领的职责了吗？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Marina, I don't care who they are. They saved me and asked for nothing in return.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
玛丽娜，我不在乎他们是谁。他们救了我，而且没有要求任何回报。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
I didn't understand why vampires would help humans, but now I know. Dracula learned from Bomi how to be more human.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我不明白为什么吸血鬼会帮助人类，但现在我明白了。德古拉从波米那里学会了如何更像人类。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
He said he wanted to understand humans, so he could better understand her. And I think he's achieved his goal.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
他说他想了解人类，这样就能更好地理解她。我想他已经做到了。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
He helped me and expected nothing in return. Such a random act of kindness is a human trait, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
他帮助了我，却没有任何回报。这种随性的善意，不正是人类的特质吗？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
And you shouldn't help someone because of who they are. Marina, are you really going to let him die because he's not one of us?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
而且，你不应该因为对方是谁而拒绝帮助。玛丽娜，你真的要因为他不是我们的一员，就让他死吗？

scripts.text:
[Marina]
That only applies to us humans. They're vampires!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
那只适用于我们人类。他们是吸血鬼！

scripts.text:
[King]
Now I understand why Dracula was so distrustful of you humans. I thought he was being too picky.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
现在我明白德古拉为什么那么不信任你们人类了。我还以为他只是太挑剔了。

scripts.text:
[King]
Hey, you monk, over there. What do you think makes you human? What do you think makes a vampire a vampire? What if there's a vampire that's never hurt anyone in their life?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
嘿，那边的武僧。你觉得是什么让你成为人类？你觉得是什么让吸血鬼成为吸血鬼？如果有一个吸血鬼，他一生从未伤害过任何人呢？

scripts.text:
[Marina]
I'll get rid of them.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
我会除掉他们。

scripts.text:
[King]
What if there's a human who did nothing but hurt others. What would you do about them?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
如果有一个人类，他一生除了伤害别人什么也没做。你会怎么对待他们？

scripts.text:
[Marina]
I'll let justice decide their fate.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
我会让正义决定他们的命运。

scripts.text:
[King]
When I hunt, I treated all humans equally because I'm a vampire. That's my rule.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
我狩猎时，平等对待所有人类，因为我是吸血鬼。这是我的规则。

scripts.text:
[King]
Their rule is to help anyone who needs help regardless of who they are. Simple, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
他们的规则是帮助任何需要帮助的人，不管他们是谁。很简单，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Marina]
...

[Dracula]
Mm... Bomi?
scripts.translation:
[德古拉]
嗯...波米？

scripts.text:
[Dracula]
Did you... save me? I thought you wanted me to die.
scripts.translation:
[德古拉]
是你...救了我吗？我以为你想让我死。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
No, and now I understand why you made that decision. You couldn't just let me die, could you?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
不，现在我也明白你为什么做那个决定了。你不可能眼睁睁看着我死，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Because I couldn't do it, either.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
因为我也不忍心。

scripts.text:
[Dracula]
...

[Gem]
Brothers. Sisters. We need to talk.
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
兄弟们。姐妹们。我们需要谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Thank you, and I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
谢谢你，对不起。

scripts.text:
[Dracula]
I'm sorry I broke my promise. But even if I could go back in time, I would do it again.
scripts.translation:
[德古拉]
抱歉我违背了诺言。但即使能回到过去，我还会做出同样的选择。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I understand now why you did that.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我现在明白你为什么要那样做了。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Did you guys make up? Dracula, the worst is over. You just need to rest and regain your energy.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
你们和好了吗？德古拉，最坏的时候已经过去了。你只需要休息，恢复<死亡骑士>能量。

scripts.text:
[Dracula]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[德古拉]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[King]
*Snort* You can't beat mushrooms, but you can save vampires.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
*哼* 你们打不过蘑菇，但你们能救吸血鬼。

scripts.text:
[King]
Drac, let's go. I know you're not hurting anymore. We should really go back to our castle this time.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
德古拉，我们走吧。我知道你不疼了。这次我们真的该回城堡了。

scripts.text:
[Dracula]
I'm going to stay.
scripts.translation:
[德古拉]
我要留下来。

scripts.text:
[King]
What? No! You've made up with her. It's time to leave!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
什么？不行！你们已经和好了。该走了！

scripts.text:
[Gem]
Please hear me out.
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
请听我说。

scripts.text:
[Gem]
We know you haven't hurt anyone, and you want to keep it that way. And we appreciate you saved Brother Jojo.
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
我们知道你没有伤害任何人，而且你也想保持这样。我们也感激你救了乔乔兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Gem]
But that doesn't change the fact that your existence in itself defies our god's will. We can't leave you alone.
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
但这改变不了一个事实：你的存在本身违背了神的旨意。我们不能放任你不管。

scripts.text:
[King]
Drac, they won't leave us alone. Let's just get rid of them!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
德古拉，他们不会放过我们的。我们先把他们解决掉吧！

scripts.text:
[Marina]
Sister Gem, this is just a waste of time. They're going to kill us the first chance they get. Let's get rid of of them before they do!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
杰姆姐妹，这只是浪费时间。他们一有机会就会杀了我们。趁他们动手前，我们先解决他们！

scripts.text:
[Antoine]
Sisters, let me talk. Your tendency to jump to conclusions is not helping this situation.
scripts.translation:
[安托万]
姐妹们，让我来说。你们急于下结论的做法无助于解决当前状况。

scripts.text:
[Antoine]
We understand you don't want to hurt anyone.
scripts.translation:
[安托万]
我们理解你们不想伤害任何人。

scripts.text:
[Antoine]
But you're dangerous to others, whether you like it or not.
scripts.translation:
[安托万]
但无论你们是否愿意，你们对他人来说都是危险的。

scripts.text:
[King]
Why are you looking at me? I didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你们为什么看着我？我什么都没做！

scripts.text:
[Antoine]
Now that we know you exist, we can't ignore you. I can, but these people here can't. Their church won't allow it.
scripts.translation:
[安托万]
既然知道了你们的存在，我们就不能无视。我可以，但这里的人不行。他们的教会不允许。

scripts.text:
[Antoine]
We're not going to make any decision. Instead, we'll ^0000cdstay here with you^000000.
scripts.translation:
[安托万]
我们不会做任何决定。相反，我们会^0000cd留在这里陪你们^000000。

scripts.text:
[King]
So you can keep an eye on us. Drac, I can't take this anymore!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
所以你们可以监视我们。德古拉，我受不了了！

scripts.text:
[King]
What? Drac! Stop acting like a human! We're proud, dignified vampires!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
什么？德古拉！别像人类那样行事了！我们是高贵、有尊严的吸血鬼！

scripts.text:
[Dracula]
Let's go back. I'm tired. I want to sleep.
scripts.translation:
[德古拉]
我们回去吧。我累了，想睡觉。

scripts.text:
[King]
I'm not happy with this arrangement, Drac. I'm going back to our castle once you get better, got it?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
德古拉，我对这个安排很不满意。等你好了，我就回城堡，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Gem]
So we've come to an agreement. We'll leave now.
scripts.translation:
[杰姆]
既然我们达成了协议，那我们现在就离开。

scripts.text:
[Marina]
You! I'm watching you! Better keep your coffin lid shut tight while you sleep!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽娜]
你！我会盯着你的！睡觉的时候最好把棺材盖关紧点！

scripts.text:
[Antoine]
I should leave too. Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[安托万]
我也该走了。失礼了。

scripts.text:
[King]
Argh! I don't ever want to see them again! Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
啊！我再也不想见到他们了！我们走！

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我们走。

scripts.text:
[Dracula]
Bomi, I'll see you when I get better.
scripts.translation:
[德古拉]
波米，等我好了再来看你。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Okay, go.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
好的，去吧。

scripts.text: Finally, they all left. That was close.
scripts.translation: 终于，他们都走了。真是好险。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Thank you, Adventurer. Everything went well, and no one got hurt because of you.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
谢谢你，冒险者。一切都很顺利，也没有人因为你而受伤。

scripts.text: You asked me if you looked like a human. Remember?
scripts.translation: 你曾问我看起来像不像人类。还记得吗？

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I do.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我记得。

scripts.text: What do you think defines a human?
scripts.translation: 你认为什么定义了一个人？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't know you when you were a human, but I don't think you were different from who you are now. You're still trying to protect what's important to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不认识你作为人类时的样子，但我觉得你和你现在并没有不同。你依然在努力保护对你重要的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think you're more human than anyone else I know. You also taught a vampire humanity.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得你比我认识的任何人都更像人类。你还教会了一个吸血鬼什么是人性。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
...Thank you. I never imagined someone would say such kind words to me one day, but I've longed to hear them.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
...谢谢你。我从未想过有一天会有人对我说这么温暖的话，但我一直渴望听到。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I couldn't get over the fact that I became a monster, but now I know better. I may not be a human anymore, but I'm still me.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我一直无法接受自己变成了魔物，但现在我明白了。我虽然不再是人类，但我依然是我。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I should go. It's time I report back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我该走了。是时候回去汇报情况了。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Okay. Travel safely. And thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
好的。一路顺风。还有，谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Didn't you say you have to report back? Go to the exit. I smelled your friends there.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
你不是说要回去汇报吗？去出口吧。我闻到你的同伴在那里。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Adventurer, thank you for trying to help me, but I don't want you to strain yourself. Why don't you rest for now?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
冒险者，谢谢你愿意帮我，但我不想让你太辛苦。现在先休息一下吧？

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
You can come back after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
天亮之后你可以再来。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I'm away right now. Please come back after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我现在不在。请天亮之后再来。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Adventurer, welcome back. Could you help me today as usual?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
冒险者，欢迎回来。今天能像往常一样帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Bomi is away. She has left a note.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
波米不在。她留了一张纸条。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need ^0000cd10 Sticky Bloods from Matte Drainliars and 10 Mushroom Saps from Neon Mushrooms^000000. You can get them if you hunt at least ^0000cd5 Matte Drainliars and 5 Neon Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我需要^0000cd10 10个来自暗色红蝙蝠的粘稠毒血，以及10个来自霓虹蘑菇的蘑菇汁^000000。如果你至少狩猎^0000cd5 5只暗色红蝙蝠和5只霓虹蘑菇^000000，就能获得它们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Adventurer, did you report already? Do you have something else to do here?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
冒险者，你汇报完了吗？你在这里还有别的事要做吗？

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
If you're not busy, could you help me with something?
scripts.translation:
[波米]
如果你不忙的话，能帮我做点事吗？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text: I'm kind of busy at the moment.
scripts.translation: 我现在有点忙。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Oh, are you? I'm sorry. Maybe you could come back later? no, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
哦，是吗？抱歉。也许你可以晚点再来？不，算了。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
As you know, I live on that fake blood that I make with the ingredients I find around here. I'm thinking I'll make some more for Dracula as well.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
你知道的，我靠用周围找到的材料制作的假血为生。我想着也给德古拉做一些。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
But since this fake blood is not pure, drinking it regularly causes your body to accumulate toxins, which drive you insane until they are completely purged from your system.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
但这种假血不纯，长期饮用会导致体内毒素堆积，使人发疯，直到毒素被完全排出体外。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
But maybe that only happens to me. I'm a new vampire, and I'm weak. Dracula has lived for a long time, and he's anything but weak.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
不过也许只有我会这样。我是新吸血鬼，身体很弱。德古拉活了很久，他一点也不弱。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Anyway, I need ^0000cd10 Sticky Bloods from Matte Drainliars and 10 Mushroom Saps from Neon Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
总之，我需要^0000cd10 10个来自暗色红蝙蝠的粘稠毒血，以及10个来自霓虹蘑菇的蘑菇汁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
You can find them if you hunt at least ^0000cd5 Matte Drainliars and 5 Neon Mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
如果你至少狩猎^0000cd5 5只暗色红蝙蝠和5只霓虹蘑菇^000000，就能找到它们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Bomi is away. I'll just leave these here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
波米不在。我就把这些留在这里吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think I forgot something.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得我忘了什么东西。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Adventurer, did you forget what I asked? I need ^0000cd10 Sticky Bloods from Matte Drainliars and 10 Mushroom Saps from Neon Mushrooms^000000. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
冒险者，你忘了我让你带什么了吗？我需要^0000cd10 10个来自暗色红蝙蝠的粘稠毒血，以及10个来自霓虹蘑菇的蘑菇汁^000000。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Bomi is away. I'll just leave these here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
波米不在。我就把这些留在这里吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think I forgot something.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得我忘了什么东西。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Adventurer, did you forget what I asked? I need ^0000cd10 Sticky Bloods from Matte Drainliars and 10 Mushroom Saps from Neon Mushrooms^000000. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
冒险者，你忘了我让你带什么了吗？我需要^0000cd10 10个来自暗色红蝙蝠的粘稠毒血，以及10个来自霓虹蘑菇的蘑菇汁^000000。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Bomi is away. I'll just leave these here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
波米不在。我就把这些留在这里吧。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Adventurer, thank you for bringing these to me.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
冒险者，谢谢你把这些带给我。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
By the way, I told you about the dangers of this fake blood. Remember? It leaves toxins in my system.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
顺便说一句，我告诉过你这种假血的危险，记得吗？它会在我的体内留下毒素。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Right now, there are so many toxins in my body that I can feel like I'm turning into a monster.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
现在，我体内的毒素太多了，我感觉自己快要变成魔物了。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I can't wait it out like I used to.
Not when there are people to worry about.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我不能像以前那样硬撑了。
因为还有让我忧心的人。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
When I turn into a monster, I want you to stop me from hurting them. Please, help me.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
如果我变成了魔物，请阻止我伤害他们。拜托了，帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Then please come back after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
那么请在黎明之后再来。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
I ran out of the ingredients I had.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
我的材料用完了。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
If I mix them like this and drink...
scripts.translation:
[波米]
如果我这样混合然后喝下去...

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Oh, no! There is too many toxins in my body. It's getting dangerous!
scripts.translation:
[波米]
哦，不！我体内的毒素太多了。情况很危险！

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
If I drink this toxic blood about thirty times, I might turn? oh, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
如果我喝下这种有毒的血大约三十次，我可能会变异？哦，算了。

scripts.text:
[Bomi]
Then please come back after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[波米]
那么请在黎明之后再来。

scripts.text:
[King]
Hey, why are you carrying so much? Go lighten your bag first.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
嘿，你为什么背了这么多东西？先去减轻一下你的背包吧。

scripts.text:
[King]
What, do you have business with me? If not, shoo!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
怎么，你有事找我吗？如果没有，快滚！

scripts.text:
[King]
I smell ^0000cdblood^000000! Human blood!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
我闻到了^0000cd血^000000的味道！是人的血！

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
You can't be smelling me. I'm not bleeding anymore. I already healed!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
你不可能在闻我。我不再流血了。我已经治好了！

scripts.text:
[King]
No. It's from somewhere else, and I'm smelling more than one human. ...A ^0000cdfight^000000! A fight broke out somewhere! Blood! Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
不。是从别的地方传来的，而且我闻到了不止一个人的味道。...一场^0000cd战斗^000000！某处爆发了战斗！血腥味！我们走！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A fight? ...No. What if the people from the Church found Bomi?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
战斗？...不。万一教会的人找到了波米怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Dracula]
What people from the Church?
scripts.translation:
[德古拉]
什么教会的人？

scripts.text:
[King]
*Sniff* This way! The smell is coming from this way!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
*嗅嗅* 这边！气味是从这边传来的！

scripts.text:
[King]
*Sniff* This way! The smell is coming from this way!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
*嗅嗅* 这边！气味是从这边传来的！

scripts.text:
[King]
Why are you looking at me like that? Dracula needs more rest. Do not disturb him.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你为什么那样看着我？德古拉需要更多的休息。不要打扰他。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Adventurer, you're back already.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
冒险者，你回来了。

scripts.text:
[King]
Yes, why did you come back so quickly? I don't want to be disturbed right now. Come back later.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
是的，你怎么这么快就回来了？我现在不想被打扰。晚点再来吧。

scripts.text:
[King]
The adventurer is here!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
冒险者来了！

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
The adventurer is here!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
冒险者来了！

scripts.text: Why are you so excited to see me?
scripts.translation: 你为什么这么兴奋？

scripts.text:
[King]
You'll take care of those Matte Drainliars like you did the last time, right? They're too loud.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你会像上次那样处理那些红蝙蝠吧？它们太吵了。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
And you'll get some ^0000cdShort Bat Hairs^000000 too, right? I need a lot more than what you brought last time.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
你也会带一些^0000cd蝙蝠短毛^000000回来吧？我需要的数量比上次你带来的多得多。

scripts.text:
[King]
^0000cd10 Matte Drainliars^000000!

[Jojo]
Thank you in advance!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
先谢过了！

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Ah, Adventurer. Good to see you again! Dracula is doing better, though he sleeps all day.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
啊，冒险者。很高兴再次见到你！德古拉好多了，虽然他整天都在睡觉。

scripts.text:
[King]
He's fully recovered, but he still doesn't want to leave. I don't know why he's so infatuated with that turned human.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
他已经完全康复了，但还是不想离开。我不知道他为什么对那个变成吸血鬼的人类如此着迷。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Oh, do you mean Bomi? I thought she was a vampire like Dracula.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
哦，你是说波米吗？我以为她和德古拉一样是吸血鬼。

scripts.text:
[King]
Not all vampires are the same. We're different from her. By the way, why are you still here? Dracula doesn't need you anymore.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
并不是所有吸血鬼都一样。我们和她不同。顺便问一下，你为什么还在这里？德古拉不需要你了。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Well, there are things around here that I want to study, and...
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
嗯，这里有一些我想研究的东西，而且...

scripts.text:
[King]
Do you have a death wish? Haven't you noticed how hungry and ferocious these bats are? They latch onto anything that moves, these creeps! Take care of them for me, will you?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你是想死吗？你没注意到这些蝙蝠有多饥饿和凶猛吗？它们会扑向任何移动的东西，这些家伙！帮我处理掉它们，好吗？

scripts.text: They're annoying.
scripts.translation: 它们很烦人。

scripts.text: Um, I'm kind of busy.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我有点忙。

scripts.text:
[King]
Oh, are you? Then go. Go away.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
哦，是吗？那就走吧。快滚。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
King, you don't have to be so mean.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
国王，你不用这么刻薄。

scripts.text:
[King]
He was mean to me first! And he said he's busy. That's why I said go. Go!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
是他先对我刻薄的！而且他说他忙。所以我才让他走。快滚！

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Well, they don't bother me as long as I stay close to Dracula and King.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
只要我待在德古拉和国王身边，它们就不会打扰我。

scripts.text:
[King]
But they drink zombie blood! Yuk! I'll never drink dead blood, no matter how hungry I am. That's disgraceful!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
但它们喝腐尸的血！恶心！无论多饿，我都绝不会喝死人的血。真是丢人！

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
So you're hating your own kind.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
所以你在讨厌自己的同类。

scripts.text:
[King]
In case you have forgotten, do you know how you're still standing there, breathing?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
如果你忘了的话，你知道自己为什么还能站在这里呼吸吗？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
...How?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
...为什么？

scripts.text:
[King]
Because I let you. And I'm letting you breathe not because you're worth living, but because I'm too lazy to kill you.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
因为我允许你。我让你呼吸，不是因为你值得活着，而是因为我懒得杀你。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
...Oh. Thank you for everything. Um, I think it's time I should rejoin my group.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
...哦。谢谢你所做的一切。嗯，我想我该回去找我的队伍了。

scripts.text:
[King]
I'm still talking to you. You're not afraid of me because I'm in bat form, are you? You humans are so stupid, you can't get past what you see.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
我还在跟你说话呢。你不怕我变成蝙蝠的样子吗？你们人类真蠢，根本看不透表象。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
I agree that these bats are disgraceful, shameless, and disgusting animals.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我同意，这些蝙蝠是令人作呕、不知廉耻、恶心的动物。

scripts.text:
[King]
Did you just call me a disgusting animal?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你刚才是在叫我恶心动物吗？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
No, no. Not you. I'm talking about Matte Drainliars.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
不，不。不是指你。我说的是红蝙蝠。

scripts.text: I have a question for you, King.
scripts.translation: 国王，我有问题想问你。

scripts.text:
[King]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
是什么？

scripts.text: Why are you in bat form?
scripts.translation: 你为什么是蝙蝠形态？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Yes. If you hate them so much, then why don't you go back to your original form?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
是的。如果你这么讨厌它们，为什么不恢复原形？

scripts.text:
[King]
That's because this form is more efficient. I don't have to drink a lot to get full, I'm inconspicuous, and people, like that numskull over there, let their guard down around me.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
因为这种形态更高效。我不需要喝很多就能饱，我不显眼，而且像那边那个笨蛋一样的人，在我面前会放松警惕。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
I'm not a numskull. I wouldn't have become a wizard if I was. And don't forget, I saved Dracula!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我不是笨蛋。如果是笨蛋，我就不会成为巫师了。别忘了，我救了德古拉！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But why a bat? There are other small animals.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但为什么是蝙蝠？还有其他小动物的。

scripts.text:
[King]
Because bats are stealthy, and they can fly. Oh, speaking of which, did you know the short hair of Matte Drainliars is used for making cloaking capes?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
因为蝙蝠隐蔽，而且能飞。对了，你知道红蝙蝠的短毛可以用来制作伪装斗篷吗？

scripts.text: Huh? No, I've never heard that.
scripts.translation: 什么？我从没听说过。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Cloaking capes? Thieves and their ilk must love those.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
伪装斗篷？盗贼之流肯定很喜欢这种东西。

scripts.text:
[King]
I can't believe how simple-minded you are.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
真不敢相信你如此头脑简单。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Erm, how can I get the hair? By hunting Matte Drainliars?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
呃，我该怎么获得那些毛？去猎杀红蝙蝠吗？

scripts.text:
[King]
Why, do you want to quit magic and turn to thievery?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
怎么，你想放弃魔法转行当盗贼吗？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
No. But it's always been my dream to conquer all the dungeons on the continent and become the greatest mage.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
不。但征服大陆上所有的地下城，成为最伟大的魔法师，一直是我梦想。

scripts.text:
[King]
...That's a big dream, an impossible dream. Well, anyone can dream big.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
...那是个很大的梦想，也是个不可能实现的梦想。不过，谁都可以做大梦。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Even if it's not for my dream, a cloaking cape will come in handy in various situations.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
就算不是为了梦想，伪装斗篷在各种情况下也会派上用场。

scripts.text:
[King]
I didn't know there was an aspiring thief among us. Huh.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
我没想到我们之中还有想当盗贼的人。呵。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
I said that's not what I want. Adventurer, are you busy?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我说了那不是我的目的。冒险者，你有空吗？

scripts.text:
[King]
What, you're going to ask him? Do it yourself!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
什么，你要去问他？你自己去问！

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
I have other things to do.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我还有别的事要做。

scripts.text:
[King]
Like what? Eating, sleeping, and pooping?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
比如什么？吃饭、睡觉和拉屎？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Oh, come on! You know I've been busy studying things!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
拜托！你知道我一直忙着研究东西！

scripts.text:
[King]
You mean, studying me and Dracula.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你是说，研究我和德古拉。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
...How did you...?

[King]
I've known that from the beginning. Your face is so transparent, you can't hide anything. I just didn't say anything because I found it funny that you nervously kept glancing at us.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
我从一开始就知道了。你的表情太透明了，什么都藏不住。我只是没说，因为看你紧张地一直偷看我们，我觉得挺有趣的。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
...Oh. Then can I ask you questions?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
...哦。那我能不能问你一些问题？

scripts.text:
[King]
Adventurer, are you going to get the bat hair for him? Good, that means you'll take care of those Matte Drainliars. Their flapping their wings keep me awake at night.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
冒险者，你要为他去拿蝙蝠毛吗？很好，那就意味着你会去处理那些红蝙蝠。它们扇动翅膀的声音吵得我晚上睡不着。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Why can't you do it yourself? All you have to do is just flick your finger.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
为什么你自己不去做？你只需要动动手指就行了。

scripts.text:
[King]
I can flick my finger at you if you want.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
如果你愿意，我可以动动手指弹你。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Adventurer, please bring me the bat hair. King, I mean, Mr. King, how much bat hair do I need?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
冒险者，请帮我带些蝙蝠毛来。国王，我是说，国王陛下，我需要多少蝙蝠毛呢？

scripts.text:
[King]
That depends on what kind of cape you want. Just know that it's tough to make stuff with hair.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
那取决于你想要什么样的披风。不过要知道，用毛发制作东西是很困难的。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Um, okay, then please bring me ^0000cd20 Short Bat Hairs^000000 for starters.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
嗯，好的，那先给我^0000cd20蝙蝠短毛^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[King]
While you're at it, hunt the ^0000cdMatte Drainliars^000000 around us. There are at least ^0000cd10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
既然来了，顺便把周围的^0000cd红蝙蝠^000000也猎杀一下。至少有^0000cd10^000000只。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Happy hunting, Adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
狩猎愉快，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[King]
You came back quickly. I hope you didn't forget anything.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你回来得真快。希望你没有忘记什么东西。

scripts.text:
[King]
Wizard! The adventurer has brought the hair.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
巫师！冒险者把毛带回来了。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
What am I supposed to do now?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我现在该做什么？

scripts.text:
[King]
That's for you to figure out. I'm not a cape maker, am I? But I know you would need more than that.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
那是你需要自己想办法的。我又不是做披风的，不是吗？不过我知道你需要的远不止这些。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Um... Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
嗯...冒险者？

scripts.text:
[King]
He just came back from hunting. You should let him rest, at least for the rest of the day.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
他刚打完猎回来。你应该让他休息一下，至少休息到明天。

scripts.text:
[King]
Adventurer, come back tomorrow and hunt more Matte Drainliars for me, will you? It's so quiet without them.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
冒险者，明天回来再帮我猎杀一些红蝙蝠，好吗？没有它们太安静了。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Th-then see you tomorrow, Adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
那...那明天见，冒险者...

scripts.text:
[King]
You came back quickly. I hope you didn't forget anything.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你回来得真快。希望你没有忘记什么东西。

scripts.text:
[King]
Look what we've got here. Did you forget what I asked? I told you to ^0000cdhunt 10 Matte Drainliars and bring 20 Short Bat Hairs^000000.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
看看这是什么。你忘了我让你做什么了吗？我让你^0000cd猎杀10只红蝙蝠并带回20根蝙蝠短毛^000000。

scripts.text:
[King]
Go get it done.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
去把它做完。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Are you sure you can carry all that stuff? Why don't you lighten your bag?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
你确定你能带得动这么多东西吗？为什么不减轻一下你的背包呢？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Aww, my wounds are fully healed, but I'm still in pain.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
哎呀，我的伤虽然完全好了，但还是有点疼。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
How's Mojo doing? Heh, she's so curious, I feel sorry for Brother Grimm for having to deal with her.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
莫乔怎么样了？呵呵，她太好奇了，我真替格林哥哥感到头疼，还得应付她。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
I can't leave here just yet. There are still many things in this place I want to know about.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我还不能离开这里。这个地方还有很多我想了解的事情。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
King has smelled blood. Even though that's how he found me when I was bleeding to death, it still scares me that he can do that.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
国王闻到了血腥味。虽然当初他就是这样在我血流不止时找到我的，但他能做到这一点，还是让我感到害怕。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
A fight has broken out somewhere over there. Don't you want to go check?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
那边好像打起来了。你不想去看看吗？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
I'm going to stay here for a while. It'll take for a while before Dracula fully regains his energy, and personally, there are many things that I want to know about these people.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我要在这里待一会儿。德古拉完全恢复能量还需要一段时间，而且就我个人而言，我对这些人还有很多事情想了解。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Please let Nun Gem and Mojo know.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
请告诉修女杰姆和莫乔。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Adventurer, see this luminous glow over here? It's from the shining spores you brought to me.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
冒险者，你看这里发出的微光吗？那是你带给我发光孢子发出的。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
I feel as if I traveled back in time, studying by this dim light.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我感觉自己像是穿越回了过去，在这昏暗的灯光下学习。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
I still have enough light left in these shining spores. Please come back after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
这些发光孢子还有足够的光亮。请在天亮后再来。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Adventurer! You are the light of my life!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
冒险者！你是我生命中的光！

scripts.text:
[King]
You're scaring him.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你在吓他。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Could you get me shining spores again today?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
今天能再帮我弄些发光孢子吗？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Please bring me ^0000cd10 Shining Spores^000000 from Neon Mushrooms and ^0000cd10 Clusters of Nightmares^000000 from Sweet Nightmares. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
请从魔菇那里给我^0000cd10发光孢子^000000，从幻影梦魇那里给我^0000cd10梦魇簇^000000。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Adventurer, wait!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
冒险者，等等！

scripts.text:
[King]
You misspelled that.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你拼错了。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Where? Oh, I did it again.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
哪里？哦，我又写错了。

scripts.text:
[King]
Tsk, tsk. I don't know how you've become a wizard when you can't even spell correctly.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
啧，啧。连字都拼不对，你是怎么成为巫师的。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
This is only because it's too dark to see. And stop peeking at what I'm doing!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
这只是因为太黑了看不清。还有，别偷看我正在做什么！

scripts.text:
[King]
It's not like you're writing something important.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你写的又不是什么重要的东西。

scripts.text: You two get along as well as I remember.
scripts.translation: 你们俩相处得和我记忆中一样好。

scripts.text:
[King]
What are you doing here? Don't you have things to do?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你在这里做什么？难道没有事情要做吗？

scripts.text: Jojo wanted to see me.
scripts.translation: 乔乔想见我。

scripts.text: Actually, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 其实我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Are you? I was going to ask you a favor, but I can wait.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
是吗？我本来想请你帮个忙，不过我可以等。

scripts.text:
[King]
Then you'd better go attend to your business.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
那你最好去忙你的正事吧。

scripts.text:
[King]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Since we're underground, it's too dark for me to write and read. I have a lot of information that I want to catalog, but I keep misspelling words because I can't see them clearly.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
既然我们在地下，这里太黑了，我没法写字和阅读。我有很多资料想要整理，但因为看不清，总是拼错单词。

scripts.text:
[King]
You should be able to do that with your eyes closed. You're a wizard. Didn't you learn how to summon light? But of course, if you use magic in front of me, I'll burn you to ashes.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你应该闭着眼睛也能做到。你是巫师，难道没学过召唤光线吗？不过当然，如果你在我面前使用魔法，我会把你烧成灰烬。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
I completed my guild's official wizard training program. I'm strong enough to have a contest with you!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我完成了公会的正式巫师培训项目。我足够强大，可以和你一较高下！

scripts.text:
[King]
Oh, really? Good for you!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
哦，是吗？真不错！

scripts.text:
[King]
Be honest, though. Did you really study hard? Did you attend every class, study all night, and practice hard? You'd better tell me the truth.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
不过说实话。你真的努力学习了？你每节课都去上了吗？熬夜学习并刻苦练习了吗？你最好说实话。

scripts.text:
[King]
Can you honestly say that you tried to push past your limits?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你能诚实地说，你努力突破了自己的极限吗？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
...

[King]
No, you didn't. That's why you had your butt handed to you by those mushrooms.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
不，你没有。这就是为什么你被那些蘑菇打得落花流水。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
I said they were zombies, not mushrooms!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我说的是腐尸，不是蘑菇！

scripts.text:
[King]
Zombies and mushrooms. Same difference to me.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
腐尸和蘑菇。对我来说没什么区别。

scripts.text:
[King]
You're not good enough to earn your keep. I can't believe your guild actually invested in you.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你还不够格，无法胜任你的工作。我真不敢相信你的公会竟然在你身上投资。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Then what about you? I know you can transform. But what else can you do?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
那你呢？我知道你会变形。但你还会做什么？

scripts.text:
[King]
Maybe you keep questioning me because you can't trust me. How about I teach you to be the greatest mage among humans? Would you trust me, then?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
也许你一直追问我是因为不信任我。如果我教你成为人类中最伟大的魔法师，你会信任我吗？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Erm, you want to teach me?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
呃，你想教我？

scripts.text:
[King]
Sure.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
当然。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[King]
I've studied a lot. Why do you think I have?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
我研究了很多。你觉得我为什么研究这么多？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
To become smarter?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
为了变得更聪明吗？

scripts.text:
[King]
No. Because I was bored to death!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
不。因为我无聊得要死！

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
You have all the time in the world. I'm envious of that.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
你有大把的时间。我真羡慕你。

scripts.text:
[King]
If you don't want me to teach you, that's fine by me.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
如果你不想让我教你，那也没关系。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
No, no! I'd love to! But, erm, you're not going to ask for my blood in return, are you?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
不，不！我很乐意！但是，呃，你不会要求用我的血来交换吧？

scripts.text:
[King]
*Snort* If I drink anything because I'm hungry, I wouldn't be any better than those Matte Drainliars now, would I?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
*哼* 如果我因为饿了就喝点什么，那我和现在的红蝙蝠有什么区别？

scripts.text: Jojo?
scripts.translation: 乔乔？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to keep you standing there. Could you get me some spores from Neon Mushrooms? I need some light to see what I'm writing.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
哦，对不起，我没注意到让你一直站着。你能帮我从魔菇那里弄些发光孢子吗？我需要点光来看清我在写什么。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Oh, you know how those spores glow. I want to use them to illuminate this place.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
哦，你知道那些孢子会发光。我想用它们来照亮这里。

scripts.text:
[King]
Well, then go get them yourself. Don't dump things on this adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
那就自己去拿吧。别把麻烦推给这位冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Oh, well... I'm... Neon Mushrooms are... You know.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
哦，好吧...我...魔菇是...你知道的。

scripts.text:
[King]
Where are you going to put the spores, anyway?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
反正，你打算把孢子放在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
I have an empty bottle? oh, I forgot I lost my bag when I was attacked.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
我有个空瓶？哦，我忘了，我在被袭击时丢了包。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Adventurer, could you get me some Clusters of Nightmares as well? I can mix them with the spores to make a paste and apply it on the wall.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
冒险者，你能顺便帮我弄些幻影梦魇的梦魇吗？我可以把它们和孢子混合成糊状，涂在墙上。

scripts.text:
[King]
What? That's so tacky.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
什么？那太俗气了。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
But effective nonetheless. You didn't know you could use them like that, did you?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
但很有效。你不知道可以这样用吧？

scripts.text:
[King]
Because I didn't need to.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
因为我不需要。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Then, Adventurer, please bring me ^0000cd10 Shining Spores^000000 from Neon Mushrooms and ^0000cd10 Clusters of Nightmares^000000 from Sweet Nightmares.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
那么，冒险者，请帮我从魔菇那里弄^0000cd10发光孢子^000000，从幻影梦魇那里弄^0000cd10梦魇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Adventurer, welcome back!
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
冒险者，欢迎回来！

scripts.text:
[King]
I can tell that's not enough, just by looking at it.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
光看我就知道，这不够。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Oh, you're right. You must have forgotten what I asked.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
哦，你说得对。你一定忘了我让你拿什么了。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Please bring me ^0000cd10 Shining Spores^000000 from Neon Mushrooms and ^0000cd10 Clusters of Nightmares^000000 from Sweet Nightmares. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
请从魔菇那里给我^0000cd10发光孢子^000000，从幻影梦魇那里给我^0000cd10梦魇簇^000000。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[King]
I can tell he brought everything you asked. Come on, make a paste and apply it to the wall already.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
看得出来他把你要求的东西都带来了。快点，把药膏涂在墙上吧。

scripts.text:
[Jojo]
Adventurer, thank you for helping me study. These glowing spores don't last long. Could you come back tomorrow and get me more of them?
scripts.translation:
[乔乔]
冒险者，谢谢你帮我研究。这些发光的孢子保存不了多久。你能明天再来给我弄一些吗？

scripts.text: This orb needs more time to gather enough energy before it'll work.
scripts.translation: 这个封印之球需要更多时间来聚集足够的能量才能生效。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou must be level 120 or higher to enter this area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff必须达到120级或以上才能进入该区域。^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000I feel dazed, as if I'm dreaming.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000我感到一阵眩晕，仿佛在做梦。^000000

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我携带的物品种类太多了。我应该先减轻背包的重量。

scripts.text: I have all the twigs I need. I should go back to Zeith and Vrid.
scripts.translation: 我已经收集到足够的树枝了。我该回泽伊特和弗里德那里了。

scripts.text: I checked the mound of dirt to look for twigs.
scripts.translation: 我检查了土堆，寻找树枝。

scripts.text: There's nothing inside this mound of dirt.
scripts.translation: 这个土堆里什么都没有。

scripts.text: I've found 1 ^006400Dry Twig^000000.

[Knight Aylvar]
Um.. Are you an adventurer?? I have a favor to ask you...
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
呃...你是冒险者吗？我有件事想拜托你...

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
...Oh, you need more experience. Excuse me.
It's a high risk job.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
...哦，你需要更多的经验值。抱歉。
这是一项高风险的任务。

scripts.text: - ^0000CDLevel 150 and over can do this quest.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^0000CD150级或以上才能接受此任务。^000000 -

scripts.text: What's going on?
scripts.translation: 发生了什么？

scripts.text: I'm very busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Sorry to bother you.
God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
抱歉打扰你了。
愿神保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Sorry for the sudden request.
I am from the Alberta Guard of the 1st Knights Division, Knight Aylvar.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
抱歉突然提出请求。
我是艾尔贝塔第一骑士团卫兵，骑士艾尔瓦。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Under the command of the Knights, I am on a mission to search for Alberta's 2nd Knights Division, who had disappeared in Turtle Island.
However, after meeting a violent storm, I arrived at a Turtle Island, but it didn't seem like the normal Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
在骑士团的命令下，我奉命搜寻在海龟岛失踪的艾尔贝塔第二骑士团。
然而，在遭遇了一场猛烈的风暴后，我到达了一座海龟岛，但那里似乎并不是正常的海龟岛。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
I was in danger, but someone helped me out.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
我身处险境，但有人帮了我。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
As I woke up, I felt the sea breeze from Alberta's harbor... In my hands, two pieces of this turtle shell.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
当我醒来时，我感受到了来自艾尔贝塔港口的海风...手中握着两块乌龟外壳碎片。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Here is only one piece I have right now.
My friend might have the other one. No, I mean he must still have.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
我现在只有一块碎片。
我的朋友可能拿着另一块。不，我的意思是，他一定还拿着。

scripts.text: Is your friend in trouble?
scripts.translation: 你的朋友遇到麻烦了？

scripts.text: It's unbelievable.
scripts.translation: 难以置信

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
I understand. Even for me, I am bewildered, but please hear me out. I think my friend is in danger
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
我理解。连我自己都感到困惑，但请听我解释。我觉得我的朋友正处于危险之中。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Yes, it's about my friend. Sorry for such a long story, just a little more, hear me out.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
是的，是关于我的朋友的事。抱歉说了这么多，请再听我说一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
I show these pieces to my friend, ^0000CDLeiphen^000000.
He shows big interest. ^0000CDHe said that it was made from the shell of a turtle living only on Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
我把这些碎片展示给我的朋友，^0000CD莱芬^000000。
他表现出极大的兴趣。^0000CD他说这是由一种只生活在海龟岛的海龟的壳制成的。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
After I handed the pieces to him....
My friend Leiphen who was looking at the pieces suddenly disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
在我把碎片交给他之后...
正在看着碎片的朋友莱芬突然消失了。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
It happened ^FF0000half a day ago^000000.
In the meantime, I contacted Juno University and went to Turtle Island, but I haven't achieved any results... I was hoping I could find a clue so I figure out where Leiphen disappeared to.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
那是^FF0000半天前^000000的事。
在此期间，我联系了朱诺大学并前往了海龟岛，但没有任何结果... 我希望能找到线索，弄清楚莱芬消失去了哪里。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
{0}, please help us. Can you help me find my friend?
This piece might be a clue. Please take a look.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
{0}，请帮帮我们。你能帮我找到我的朋友吗？
这块碎片可能是一个线索。请看一下。

scripts.text: Please tell me your friend looks like.
scripts.translation: 请告诉我你朋友长什么样

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
^0000CDHe wears glasses^000000 and has blue short hair. ^0000CDHis face is just like a scholar^000000 so you should be able to recognize him.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
^0000CD他戴着眼镜^000000，留着蓝色短发。^0000CD他的脸看起来就像个学者^000000，你应该能认出他。

scripts.text: Show me the piece. Let me take a look.
scripts.translation: 给我看看碎片。让我看一下

scripts.text: Sorry but I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Sorry to bother you.
God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
抱歉打扰你了。
愿神保佑你。

scripts.text: - ^424242EStopped handing the piece over.^000000 -

[Knight Aylvar]
I am sorry, {0}. You already have too much stuff. I figure it's difficult to find my friend right now.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
抱歉，{0}。你已经有很多东西了。我觉得现在很难找到我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Can you clear up your inventory a little bit? I will be right here waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
你能清理一下你的物品栏吗？我会在这里等你。

scripts.text: - ^424242I grabbed the piece handed over by the knight. A small leaf is carved on the turtle shell. It's a bulky piece, but somehow feels warm.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242我拿起了骑士递过来的碎片。乌龟外壳上刻着一片小叶子。这是一块笨重的碎片，但不知为何感觉温暖。^000000 -

scripts.text: - ^424242I was looking at the piece for a while, but suddenly something seemed to appear in my head. Suddenly a gust blows and my vision gets darker.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242我盯着碎片看了一会儿，突然脑海中似乎出现了什么。一阵雷电强化吹过，我的视野变暗了。^000000 -

scripts.text: - ^424242EAylvar's voice is getting smaller and I felt dizzy. It's starting to smell like wet clay....^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242EA尔瓦的声音越来越小，我感到头晕。开始闻到湿粘土的味道....^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
{0}! Oh, you are ok! I am... worried. After Leiphen, {1}, you also disappeared, I was really concerned.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
{0}！哦，你没事！我...很担心。在莱芬之后，{1}，你也消失了，我真的非常担心。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Are you going back to find Leiphen again?
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
你要回去再找莱芬吗？

scripts.text: Let me go there again.
scripts.translation: 让我再去那里一次

scripts.text: I will go there later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后会去那里。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Please save Leiphen.
If I can go there, I will save him myself.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
请救救莱芬。
如果我能去的话，我会亲自去救他。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Thank you. Thank you so much.
Please save Leiphen.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
谢谢你。真的非常感谢。
请救救莱芬。

scripts.text: - ^424242As the girl who was there told me, I squeezed the piece of the turtle shell, I felt the wind blowing my hair again.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242正如那个女孩所说，我捏了捏乌龟外壳的碎片，再次感觉到风吹动我的头发。^000000 -

scripts.text: - ^424242Before my eyes were completely dark, my cheeks felt the cooler air from the cave....^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242在视线完全变黑之前，我的脸颊感受到了来自洞穴的清凉空气....^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Hi {0}. I have heard every story from Leiphen.
I am worried because he went there again. He said he would come back after finds out the secret of that place.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
你好，{0}。我已经听完了莱芬讲述的所有故事。
我很担心，因为他又去了那里。他说在弄清楚那个地方的秘密后就会回来。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Not only Leiphen but also a kid named Narin... who you also helped. You are a great adventurer.
Are you going there again?
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
不仅是莱芬，还有那个叫娜琳的小孩...你也帮过她。你是一位伟大的冒险者。
你还要去那里吗？

scripts.text: Yes. I am going there.
scripts.translation: 是的，我要去那里。

scripts.text: Not right now.
scripts.translation: 现在不去。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Oh, since you are going there again, please make sure Leiphen is ok as well.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
哦，既然你又要去那里，请顺便确认一下莱芬是否安好。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Please come back again, {0}.
On the way, please make sure Leiphen is doing good.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
请再次回来，{0}。
在途中，请确认莱芬是否一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Glad to see you again. I have reported the information to the Knights Division and now my job is to support Leiphen's research.
Are you going there again?
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
很高兴再次见到你。我已经将情报汇报给骑士团，现在我的工作就是支持莱芬的研究。
你还要去那里吗？

scripts.text: Yes. I am going there.
scripts.translation: 是的，我要去那里。

scripts.text: Not right now.
scripts.translation: 现在不去。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
When I heard his story, I wanted to go there too... but I can't do as he explained. I am so sad.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
听到他的故事后，我也想去那里...但我无法像他描述的那样做到。我很伤心。

scripts.text:
[Knight Aylvar]
Please come back again, {0}.
If you find Leiphen, please make sure he is eating.
scripts.translation:
[骑士 艾尔瓦]
请再次回来，{0}。
如果你找到莱芬，请确认他有在吃东西。

scripts.text: - ^424242Beyond the door, it appears black, and nothing seems to exist. A reddish glow is floating in front of the black sky. A nervous looking girl appears.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242门后一片漆黑，似乎什么都没有存在。红色的光芒漂浮在黑色的天空中。一个神情紧张的女孩出现了。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Girl]
...It is this place.
Hopeless, desperate, and poisonous.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
...就是这里。
绝望、无助，且充满毒素。

scripts.text: - ^424242It's a puzzling response, but it might help. As the girl told me, I held onto the turtle shell.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242这是一个令人费解的回答，但也许会有帮助。正如女孩所说，我紧紧握住了乌龟外壳。^000000 -

scripts.text: Back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Stay here.
scripts.translation: 留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
......Not going to back?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
......不打算回去吗？

scripts.text: - ^424242The smell of salty wind lifted the hem of my clothing. You can hear the waves of Alberta Harbor and the sound of seagulls....^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242咸咸的海风吹起了我的衣角。你能听到艾尔贝塔港的波浪声和海鸥的叫声....^000000 -

scripts.text: - ^424242This red light is invisible to Narin. It just seems to disappear.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242这束红光对娜琳来说是隐形的。它看起来只是消失了而已。^000000 -

scripts.text: - ^424242If I don't come back, she will forget. Just right before I walk into the light, Narin's voice echoed from behind me.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242如果我不回来，她就会忘记。就在我即将走进红光的那一刻，娜琳的声音从我身后传来。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Narin]
I will remember... Come back. Please. Bro...!
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
我会记得的... 回来吧。求你了。哥...！

scripts.text: Nod and go to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 点头并前往艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Nod and turn.
scripts.translation: 点头并转身

scripts.text: - ^424242Turning around with a small smile, Narin, holding her hands, was surprised and glanced over.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242我带着淡淡的微笑转过身来。娜琳握紧双手，惊讶地瞥了我一眼。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Ah? Not going back?
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
啊？不回去了吗？

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Hey!
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
嘿！

scripts.text: - ^424242I nodded and recalled the bulky piece I had now kept by my heart. The sea breeze from the harbor blows by my ears...^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242我点了点头，想起了那件此刻紧贴在我心口的厚重物件。港口吹来的海风拂过我的耳畔...^000000 -

scripts.text: - ^424242Now I stand in front of the familiar light. Lightly waved my hand to Narin, she closed her eyes and held both hands together.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242现在我站在熟悉的红光前。我轻轻向娜琳挥了挥手，她闭上眼睛，双手合十。^000000 -

scripts.text: - ^424242With empty hands, I think of the bulky but warm piece left in my heart.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242我空着双手，想着那件留在心中、厚重却温暖的物件。^000000 -

scripts.text: Go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: Stay here.
scripts.translation: 留在这里。

scripts.text: - ^424242Turning around with a small smile, Narin, holding her hands, was surprised and glanced over.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242我带着淡淡的微笑转过身来。娜琳握紧双手，惊讶地瞥了我一眼。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Ah? Not going back?
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
啊？不回去了吗？

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Hay!
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
嘿！

scripts.text: - ^424242I will come back again. I put my hands together on my chest.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242我会再回来的。我将双手合十放在胸前。^000000 -

scripts.text: - ^424242The consciousness became far away, and the salty, slightly fishy smell of Alberta Harbor tickled my nose.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242意识渐渐远去，艾尔贝塔港那带着咸味、略显鱼腥的气息刺激着我的鼻子。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Girl]
What are you doing with such a heavy bag? Clear some out.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你背着这么重的袋子干什么？清理掉一些吧。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Again... Stranger.
And you brought that again.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
又是你... 陌生人。
而且你又带了那个东西。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
You have a lot of questions, but no need to know.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你有很多问题，但没必要知道答案。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
But ^0000CDthere is someone here like you^000000. One who shouldn't be here.
Go back with ^0000CDa scholar who has blue hair^000000. Do you know him?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
但这里^0000CD有个人和你一样^000000。一个不该出现在这里的人。
跟^0000CD那个蓝发的学者^000000回去吧。你认识他吗？

scripts.text: I am here to find him.
scripts.translation: 我是来找他的

scripts.text: Do you know Archeologist Leiphen?
scripts.translation: 你认识考古学家莱芬吗？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Good. I don't know his name and where he is, but I can guess.
^0000CDThere are two locations^000000. Go find and take him. And do not come back.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
很好。我不知道他的名字和所在之处，但我能猜到。
^0000CD有两个地点^000000。去找到他，带走他。然后不要回来。

scripts.text: Ok, but I have some questions.
scripts.translation: 好的，但我有些问题。

scripts.text: How can I believe you?
scripts.translation: 我凭什么相信你？

scripts.text: Let me know the way to go back.
scripts.translation: 告诉我回去的路。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
You will be gone for good. No need to know.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你将永远消失。没必要知道。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
A spell that will protect you for a moment.
It will follow you around. Curiosity killed the cat. Don't look into something that is unclear. Don't look back, or talk behind someone's back.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
一个能保护你片刻的咒语。
它会跟随在你身边。好奇心害死猫。不要窥探不明之物。不要回头，也不要背后议论他人。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
^FF0000Don't be alarmed that you may breathe strangely.^000000
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
^FF0000如果你呼吸变得异常，不要惊慌。^000000

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I don't know. I don't know where you came from, how could I know?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我不知道。我不知道你从哪里来，我怎么会知道？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
However, there, the empty door... might have something, you might know about.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
不过，那里，那扇空门... 也许有些东西，你会知道。

scripts.text: - ^424242The girl glanced toward the back of where she was standing. Looking closely, it seems that something reddish is floating in front of the black hole. Let's go and look.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242女孩瞥了一眼她身后的地方。仔细看，似乎有什么红色的东西漂浮在黑洞前。让我们去看看。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Go back. It's dangerous here.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
回去。这里很危险。

scripts.text: - ^424242The girl said briefly and stopped talking. She looks sad....^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242女孩简短地说完后便不再说话。她看起来很悲伤....^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Girl]
...You, still alive?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
...你，还活着？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Before you get in danger, get the person you were looking for and leave.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
在你陷入危险之前，找到你要找的人，然后离开。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
You are safe. Both of you.
...Sorry for the danger.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你们两个都安全了。
...抱歉让你们陷入危险。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Then, go back. To the place you came.
And forget everything.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
那么，回去吧。回到你来的地方。
然后忘记一切。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Huh? What do you mean? I will come back again.
Until I find out all of the secrets here.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
什么？你什么意思？我会再回来的。
直到我解开这里所有的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Why do you ignore my warnings? Arrogant.
You may be a professor but that does not give you the right to walk around here.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
为什么无视我的警告？傲慢。
你也许是位智者，但这并不代表你有权在这里四处走动。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
......Do you know something?
Please tell me. Where am I? What just happened here?
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
......你知道些什么？
请告诉我。我在哪里？刚才这里发生了什么？

scripts.text: Stop saying that.
scripts.translation: 别这么说。

scripts.text: You are the arrogant one.
scripts.translation: 你才是傲慢的人。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Stop? I didn't say anything wrong. You are going to leave and forget everything soon. You will never come back.... right?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
别？我并没有说错什么。
你马上就要离开，然后忘记一切。
你永远不会再回来了……对吧？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
......Fine. Arrogant or not. Think freely. I don't care anyway.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
......好吧。傲慢与否。
随你怎么想。反正我不在乎。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I said before.... but no one has returned. I am not expecting anyone to.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我之前说过……
但从来没有人回来过。我也不指望会有人回来。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
......No one comes back. It's better to not come here. It's full of danger.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
......没有人会回来。
最好不要来这里。这里充满了危险。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
You want that, but still someone is going to come back here.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
你虽然这么说，但还是会有人回来的。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Whew.........

[Girl]
Ok. Fine. Let me tell you. Promise me you will go back after listening. It's not like I want to talk a lot.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
好吧。行吧。让我告诉你。
答应我，听完之后就回去。我也不是想多说什么。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
...Give me a sec. I need time to think clearly. It's been a long time not talking....
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
...给我一点时间。我需要理清思路。已经很久没有和人说话了....

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I'll talk to you again after a while.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
过一会儿我再跟你说话。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Thank you for waiting...
It would be better to start introducing myself. I am Narin. ^0000CDOld Ghost.^000000
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
谢谢你的等待...
还是先自我介绍一下吧。我是娜琳。^0000CD旧幽灵。^000000

scripts.text:
[Narin]
You look like you have been through a lot of things before. I can see you are able to talk normally.
Ordinary people like a professor can't even see us.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
你看起来经历过很多事情。我能看出你能正常交流。
像智者那样的普通人，甚至看不见我们。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
All the residents here are spirits bound by the burden of resentment. When you're dead, obsessed with something you desperately want, and you'll always do the same thing without realizing it..
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
这里的居民都是被怨念束缚的精灵。当你死后，执着于某件你极度渴望的事情，你就会在不知不觉中一直重复同样的事..

scripts.text:
[Narin]
We hate life. Those who are not bound by the burden of resentment, those who breathe strangely. We want to hear your last breath.
But unless you realize us, we cannot realize you either. It's a good thing.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
我们憎恨生命。那些没有被怨念束缚的人，那些呼吸方式怪异的人。我们想听到你最后的呼吸。
但除非你意识到我们，我们也无法意识到你。这是件好事。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
It doesn't last long. The longer you stay here, the more you notice each other. Gradually.
And suddenly you guys realize. That's strange. ...Then, it's over.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
这不会持续太久。你在这里待得越久，就越能察觉到彼此。逐渐地。
然后突然你们就意识到了。这很奇怪。...然后，就结束了。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
The professor got my stuff, so I could recognize it right away. Normally I wouldn't have known.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
智者拿走了我的东西，所以我立刻认出了它。通常我是不会知道的。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Oh, I knew it...!!
It was you who saved Aylvar. Thank you for helping my friend!
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
哦，我就知道...!!
原来是你救了艾尔瓦。谢谢你帮助我的朋友！

scripts.text:
[Narin]
I wanted to do it.  My obsession is...
^0000CDU I don't want anyone get die here. I want to save all life.^000000......
It was just that.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
我想这么做。我的执念是...
^0000CD我不想让任何人死在这里。我想拯救所有生命。^000000......
仅此而已。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Oh... really, it's such a silly story. It's hard to keep talking.
Just leave me alone for a while? Sorry for taking so long.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
哦...真的，这是个很愚蠢的故事。很难继续说下去。
让我一个人待一会儿好吗？抱歉让你等了这么久。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
It's ok. I'll leave you for a moment. {0}, let's go together.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
没关系。我先离开一会儿。{0}，我们走吧。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Thank you for waiting. I'm good now. Let me finish.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
谢谢你的等待。我现在好多了。让我说完吧。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
It's not the first time, someone is here. It's a rare event. When I first saw someone, I remembered what I wanted.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
这不是第一次有人来到这里。这是罕见的事件。当我第一次看到有人时，我想起了我的愿望。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
The man was deathly afraid, but he was alive and left this place.
After that... I could stay a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
那个男人吓得要死，但他还活着，离开了这里。
在那之后...我就能多待一会儿了。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
It's been a while, I haven't lost my mind. I was not swept away by resentment and neither reason nor emotion was lost.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
已经有一段时间了，我没有失去理智。我没有被怨恨冲昏头脑，也没有失去理智和情感。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
So I want to save all life. Those who have flowed in and even those trapped by the burden forever.
I realized that all those I saved went back to where they came from.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
所以我想拯救所有生命。那些已经流逝的，以及那些永远被重担束缚的。
我意识到，所有我救下的人都回到了他们来的地方。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
It's... it's hard. Even I envy those trapped by this burden. But... I couldn't turn it off. The people who are in danger.
....
But I don't want to hope. If you hope... you can be betrayed.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
这...很难。甚至我羡慕那些被重担束缚的人。但是...我无法停止。那些处于危险中的人。
....
但我不想抱有希望。如果你抱有希望...你可能会被背叛。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Oh, I almost forgot. Let me cast my spell on you again. It's weak, so it will not last long.
Just get out before it's over.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
哦，我差点忘了。让我再对你施一次法。它很弱，所以不会持续太久。
在结束之前离开这里。

scripts.text: It's been hard on you being alone.
scripts.translation: 你一个人很不容易。

scripts.text: I am not going back.
scripts.translation: 我不回去了。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
......I didn't tell you the long story to hear that...
Please don't care about me....
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
......我讲这么长的故事不是为了听这个...
请不要担心我....

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
{0}, it turns out that you speak very well.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
{0}，看来你很会说话。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
What are you talking about?! I said go back after you listen to my whole story...!
I don't want to worry anymore!
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
你在说什么？！我让你听完我的故事后再回去...！
我不想再担心了！

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Yes. That's what I wanted to say.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
是的。这就是我想说的。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
What do you mean...?
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
你什么意思...？

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Let us help other souls here like you, Narin, resolve themselves.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
让我们像你一样，帮助这里的其他灵魂，娜琳，解决他们的问题。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Oh really...
......No, it was a coincidence. They are, not like me.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
真的吗...
......不，那是巧合。他们，不像我。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
We will see. Right?
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
我们会看到的。对吧？

scripts.text:
[Narin]
It's ok. I will forget both of you. All the souls here are made like that.
I might remember a little longer. But I forget eventually.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
没关系。我会忘记你们两个。这里的所有灵魂都是这样的。
我可能会记得久一点。但我最终会忘记。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
We can guess one fact. All the lost memories are in the subconscious mind of Narin.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
我们可以推测出一个事实。所有丢失的记忆都在娜琳的潜意识中。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
I will come back. For research and for you, Narin.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
我会回来的。为了研究，也为了你，娜琳。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Really... Really? Are you going to come back here and find me?
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
真的吗... 真的吗？你会回来这里找到我吗？

scripts.text:
[Narin]
I don't need to be ... alone...?
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
我不需要... 一个人... 吗？

scripts.text: I won't leave you alone.
scripts.translation: 我不会让你一个人。

scripts.text: Don't worry.
scripts.translation: 不用担心

scripts.text: I promise.
scripts.translation: 我保证。

scripts.text: I will come back.
scripts.translation: 我会回来的。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
......Thanks...

[Narin]
Thanks... Really...
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
谢谢... 真的...

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Hu? Huh? It's just gone. The {0}.
Suddenly from my hands... like it melted away.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
咦？啊？它不见了。那个{0}。
突然从我手中... 就像融化了一样。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
It has my wishes. Now... It doesn't need to exist.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
它承载着我的愿望。现在... 它不需要存在了。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
...I, I don't know the specifics reason... Just that it might be that way.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
...我，我不知道具体原因... 只是觉得可能是这样。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
...Oh, right. Here... I give this to you. Here, you too professor.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
...啊，对了。这个... 给你。还有你，智者。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
It's a sign of promise. I will try to remember the two of you. So come... come and find me.
Tomorrow, and the day after tomorrow... I'll be waiting... Brother and professor.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
这是约定的信物。我会试着记住你们两个的。所以请... 请来找找我。
明天，还有后天... 我会等着... 哥哥和智者。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
And the others... you said you would help them. I'll show you how. How you can help...
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
还有其他人... 你说你会帮他们的。我会告诉你怎么做。怎么帮助他们...

scripts.text:
[Narin]
^0000CDListen to what they want. Brother, even if you look very trivial, do something they'll be pleased by.^000000
Please... Maybe one day...
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
^0000CD倾听他们的愿望。哥哥，即使看起来微不足道，也要做让他们开心的事。^000000
拜托了... 也许有一天...

scripts.text: Don't worry. I will.
scripts.translation: 别担心。我会的。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
:)...

[Narin]
I, I was able to stay alone so far, because I could meet you two again someday?
I will... remember... Please... come back.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
我，我能一直一个人待着，是因为我知道总有一天能再见到你们两个吗？
我会... 记住的... 拜托... 回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
I will be here until I find all of the secrets.
Don't worry. {0} and myself will not forget about you Narin.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
我会留在这里，直到解开所有的秘密。
别担心。{0}和我不会忘记你的，娜琳。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
I asked you to come back... but you must leave today. It's dangerous to be here any longer.
There is a limit to the protection spell.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
我让你回来... 但你今天必须离开。在这里待太久很危险。
保护咒语是有时限的。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
The day is over and you two stay together. I'll give you a new spell.
If I forget again... Please I will try to remember...
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
今天结束了，你们两个要一起留下。我会给你们一个新的咒语。
如果我再次忘记...请让我试着记住...

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Brother... Are you still here? The spell will be gone after a day, please come back after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
哥哥...你还在吗？咒语一天后就会消失，请在黎明后回来。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Even if I forget you brother, don't go away...please.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
即使我忘记了哥哥，也不要离开...拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Again... Stranger.
Go back. It's dangerous...
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
又是...陌生人。
回去吧。这里很危险...

scripts.text: - ^424242She can't remember, but even if she doesn't remember, she's different from the other ghosts.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242她不记得了，但即使她不记得，她也和其他幽灵不同。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Narin]
......Why are you mumbling like that?
Go back. You do not belong here.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
......你在那嘟囔什么？
回去吧。你不属于这里。

scripts.text: What does was she want...
scripts.translation: 她想要什么...

scripts.text: Go back now.
scripts.translation: 现在回去

scripts.text: - ^424242Let's go back now. It looks like nothing has happened to the professor, yet. I will come back later.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242我们先回去吧。看起来教授暂时没事。我稍后再来。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Go back, stranger. And never be back.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
回去吧，陌生人。永远不要再回来。

scripts.text:
- ^424242...She wants me to leave with Archeologist Leiphen. Then she will remember...
The professor will just come back. Let's find him.^000000 -
scripts.translation:
- ^424242...她希望我和考古学家 莱芬离开。那样她就能记起来了...
教授会回来的。我们去找他吧。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Go back. ...you not should be here.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
回去吧。...你不应该在这里。

scripts.text:
- ^424242...She wants me to leave with Archeologist Leiphen. Then she will remember...
The professor will just come back. Let's find him.^000000 -
scripts.translation:
- ^424242...她希望我和考古学家 莱芬离开。那样她就能记起来了...
教授会回来的。我们去找他吧。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
I came here again. Well, everyday.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
我又来了。嗯，每天都是这样。

scripts.text:
[Narin]
......Again ...I forgot again.....
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
......又是这样...我又忘记了.....

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Thank you... Um, let me cast a spell on you. You will go to the others as well today?
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
谢谢你...嗯，让我给你施加一个咒语。你今天也会去其他人那里吗？

scripts.text:
[Narin]
Hope you two will be safe...
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
希望你们两个平安...

scripts.text:
[Narin]
And here, a sign of promise. Professor and brother. I'm glad you came.
I will be waiting for tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[娜琳]
还有这个，作为约定的信物。
智者和哥哥，很高兴你们能来。
我会在这里等到明天。

scripts.text:
[Impatient Man]
I lost her. I lost her. My baby. My pretty baby. Where are you? My baby. What's her name? My daughter. Daughter? My baby.
scripts.translation:
[急躁的男子]
我弄丢她了。我弄丢她了。我的宝宝。我漂亮的宝宝。你在哪里？我的宝宝。她叫什么名字？我的女儿。女儿？我的宝宝。

scripts.text: - ^424242As she told me, there are others... but he doesn't look like Archeologist Leiphen.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242正如她所说，还有其他人...但他看起来不像考古学家 莱芬。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Impatient Man]
Who was it? My baby, where are you? My daughter? My.... daughter? Ha, hahaha. I lost her. I lost her
scripts.translation:
[急躁的男子]
那是谁？我的宝宝，你在哪里？我的女儿？我的....女儿？哈，哈哈哈。我弄丢她了。我弄丢她了

scripts.text: Are you looking for your baby?
scripts.translation: 你在找你的宝宝吗？

scripts.text: Do you want my help?
scripts.translation: 需要我的帮助吗？

scripts.text:
[Impatient Man]
No. ^FF0000You can't^000000.
scripts.translation:
[急躁的男子]
不。^FF0000你不行^000000。

scripts.text:
[Impatient Man]
No. ^FF0000No.^000000 Can't find her.
scripts.translation:
[急躁的男子]
不。^FF0000不行。^000000 找不到她。

scripts.text:
[Impatient Man]
No ^FF0000it can't be. My daughter.^000000 Baby... Baby? No. Ha, ha^FF0000haha. No. Ha, ha.^000000 My ^FF0000pretty baby,^000000, baby. My ^FF0000 pretty baby. No.^000000 No.
