[Archeologist Leiphen]
Oh my god... Human, a human? A real human?
Oh thank God! Thank you. I thought I was going to die here!
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
天哪...人类，是人类？真正的人类？
感谢神明！谢谢你。我以为自己要死在这里了！

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
huu... without Aylvar and {0} I would have died.
^FF0000I couldn't sleep^000000 and eat for several days. I was wandering around.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
呼...如果没有艾尔瓦和{0}，我早就死了。
^FF0000我睡不着^000000，也吃不下东西，好几天了。我一直在四处游荡。

scripts.text: - ^424242Several days? It's weird.^000000 -

[Archeologist Leiphen]
Anyway, have you heard from Aylvar? I was hesitant when I heard.
...Aylvar was right about this place.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
总之，你收到艾尔瓦的消息了吗？听到时我有些犹豫。
...艾尔瓦对这个地方的判断是对的。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
There are a lot of things I'd like to research, but it's better to go back for now.
I'm exhausted and don't have some tools to make proper reasoning. It's better to prepare and come back.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
这里有很多我想研究的东西，但现在最好先回去。
我精疲力竭，而且缺少合适的工具来进行严谨的推理。最好做好准备后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Of course I have to come back. It's a place where I can discover all new facts about the history of Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
当然我会回来的。这里是能发现海龟岛历史全新事实的地方。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
I'll take that as a compliment.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
我会把这当作夸奖。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
hum...
I'm sorry but I'm hungry... I can't move right now.
If you are okay, can you hunt some monsters around?
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
嗯...
抱歉，我饿了...现在动不了。
如果你不介意，能帮我在附近打些魔物吗？

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
The essence is a turtle, so I can eat but I couldn't hunt alone, so I starved all this time....
The monsters here are much stronger than the monsters on the Turtle Island we know. Please?
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
本质上是海龟，所以我能吃，但我无法独自狩猎，所以这段时间一直挨饿....
这里的魔物比我们熟知的海龟岛上的魔物强得多。拜托了？

scripts.text: What kind of monster do you want?
scripts.translation: 你想让我打哪种魔物？

scripts.text: I think it's better to just go.
scripts.translation: 我觉得还是直接走吧。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
...I'm sorry, can't move.
Can you carry me out?
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
...抱歉，动不了。
能背我出去吗？

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Well, if the monster hunting is too cumbersome... you can carry me out..
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
嗯，如果打魔物太麻烦的话...你可以背我出去..

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Thank you for accepting. Well, I think it's better to think of these monsters as different ones from Turtle Island.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
谢谢你的接受。嗯，我觉得最好把这些魔物看作与海龟岛不同的种类。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
^0000CD{0}, {1}, {2}, {3}. ^0000CD10 monsters each.^000000 Please.
And ^0000CDthe meat^000000, ^0000CD10 pieces^000000 please.

[Archeologist Leiphen]
In the meantime, I will make a fire.
Phew... I'm struggling all of a sudden. I'm an archaeologist, not a hero of an adventure story.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
在此期间，我会生火。
呼...我突然觉得很吃力。我是考古学家，不是冒险故事里的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Oops... The fire didn't go well. I can't burn books or tools.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
哎呀...火没生好。我不能烧书或工具。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
No way... All of it?
^0000CD{0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, ^000000ALL?

[Archeologist Leiphen]
...Well, let me take ^0000CDthe {0} ^00000010 pieces, ^0000CDlet me try first^000000 please.
I can't move without chewing and swallowing something...
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
...好吧，先给我^0000CD{0} ^00000010块，^0000CD让我先试试^000000 拜托了。
不嚼点东西吞下去，我根本动不了...

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Too bad. There was nothing to burn... So I can't make a fire.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
真遗憾。没有可以烧的东西...所以我生不起火。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
That's really weird. You hunt living monsters, but somehow it only gives rotten meat?
I can't cook the rotten meat, but I can try to eat!
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
这真的很奇怪。你打的是活着的魔物，但为什么只掉落腐臭之肉？
我没法烹饪腐臭之肉，但我可以试着直接吃！

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Ugh... I can't eat. Sorry... You tried for nothing...
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
呃...我吃不下。抱歉...你白忙一顿了...

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
There is no one around here except me and you, right? I've been around here for days ^FF0000but I haven't seen anyone^000000.
If there are others, I can ask for their help.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
这里除了我和你，应该没有别人了吧？我在这里待了好几天，^FF0000但还没见过任何人^000000。
如果有其他人，我可以请求他们的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Did you see people? Oh, you should have told me earlier. Where did you see them? Let's go and talk now!
I want to ask them something!
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
你看到人了？哦，你早该告诉我的。你在哪里看到的？我们现在就过去聊聊！
我想问他们一些事情！

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
I'm ok now! Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
我现在没事了！我们走吧！

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Even if we can't talk, I can still figure something out by looking at people's lifestyle.
Okay, let's go! Please show me the way! To the nearest place!
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
即使我们不能交谈，我也可以通过观察人们的生活方式来了解一些情况。
好的，我们走吧！请带路！去最近的地方！

scripts.text:
- ^424242I didn't mean that about the talking part, but let's go anyway.
To the nearest place... ^FF0000Let's go to the hungry ^424242woman.^000000 -
scripts.translation:
- ^424242我刚才关于交谈的部分不是那个意思，但不管怎样，我们走吧。
去最近的地方... ^FF0000我们去那个饥饿的^424242女子那里吧。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
You are here again today.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
你今天又回来了。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
As I told you, I'm not going to leave until I found the secret of this place.
Are you here to go to Narin?
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
正如我告诉你的，在发现这个地方的秘密之前，我不会离开。
你是要去娜琳那里吗？

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Uh, I didn't tell you. I'm taking a sabbatical year.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
呃，我没告诉你。我正在休学一年。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[考古学家 莱芬]
我们走吧！

scripts.text: - ^424242I think I saw something.^000000 -
- ^424242It seems to be getting a little cold.^000000 -
- ^424242I feel weird, but nothing is here...^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242我觉得不对劲，但这里什么都没有...^000000 -

scripts.text: - ^424242I heard something.^000000 -
This is a totem that glows softly in blue.
scripts.translation: 这是一个发出柔和蓝光的图腾。

scripts.text: Touch it
scripts.translation: 触摸它

scripts.text: Leave it
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: - You cannot enter the area because your level is too low.
scripts.translation: - 由于等级过低，您无法进入该区域。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续。 -

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ah! Ah! Ah!
I've heard that they hire adventurers because they don't have enough hands to defend the village. I guess that's you?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
啊！啊！啊！
我听说因为人手不足，村庄雇佣了冒险者来防御。难道就是你吗？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
By the way, haven't I seen you somewhere? Your face looks strangely familiar.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
顺便问一下，我是不是在哪里见过你？你的脸看起来很眼熟。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Oops, I'm not in a position to compare similar faces... We're twins. Ha ha ha
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
哎呀，我不该比较相似的脸...我们是双胞胎。哈哈

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Should I say hello? Nice to meet you. I'm Luanda, the defense manager of this cave.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我该打个招呼吗？很高兴见到你。我是卢安达，这个洞穴的防御管理员。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
For simple quests, we have prepared a request board, so you can find them and report them to me.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
对于简单的任务，我们准备了任务板，你可以找到它们并向我汇报。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
The quest itself doesn't have to be difficult, as you just have to go around the cave and deal with the monsters or bring the byproducts of the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
任务本身不需要太难，你只需要在洞穴周围处理魔物，或者收集魔物的副产品。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Since you've been hired by the village, I'd like you to work hard and lighten the burden a bit. It's really hard these days. Please.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
既然你被村庄雇佣了，我希望你能努力工作，减轻一点负担。最近真的很难。拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Then have a good time. Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
那么祝你玩得开心。冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the strange shimmering you had witnessed.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达讲述了你目睹的奇怪闪光。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
A strange shimmer? As you said, it's a really strange phenomenon.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
奇怪的闪光？正如你所说，这确实是一个奇怪的现象。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I've lived in the village for a long time, but it seems like a phenomenon I've never heard of. I'm guessing, but I think it's just started happening recently.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我在村庄住了很久，但似乎从未听说过这种现象。我猜测，这可能是最近才开始发生的。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I don't live alone in the village, and if someone had seen it, it would have been rumored, but hearing it for the first time would make my guess clear.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我在村庄里不是独居，如果有人见过，肯定会有传闻，但这是我第一次听到，所以我的猜测应该是正确的。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It could be dangerous, so if you find it, why don't you avoid it? There's no need to take a risk.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
这可能很危险，如果你发现了，为什么不避开它呢？没必要冒险。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达汇报并获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about three young men you met and talked to.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达讲述了你遇到并交谈的三名年轻男子。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Uh.. huh?! You saw me and young men who look like like my brothers.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
呃.. 什么？！你看到了我和看起来像我兄弟的年轻男子。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It seems like it happened a long time ago. Unlike Mao, I don't have a very good memory.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
看来那是很久以前的事了。不像毛，我的记性不太好。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I vaguely remember it. I did warn a stranger I met before I went hunting with my brothers.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我隐约记得。在我和兄弟们去打猎之前，我确实警告过一个陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's not uncommon to see strangers in town, so my memory is hazy, but I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
在镇上遇到陌生人并不罕见，所以我的记忆有些模糊，但我确实记得这件事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's interesting. If what you're saying is true, doesn't that mean you've been talking to me in the past?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
这很有趣。如果你说的是真的，那岂不是意味着你过去就已经和我交谈过了？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ah! Come to think of it, do you remember the first time we met? Didn't I say I was used to being an adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
啊！仔细想想，你还记得我们第一次见面吗？我当时是不是说过我习惯了做冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
As expected, I don't think it was a bad feeling. I really can't believe it. An adventurer who met me in the past...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
果然，我觉得这感觉并不坏。我真的不敢相信。一个在过去就见过我的冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
That sounds like something similar could happen in the future, right?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
听起来未来也可能发生类似的事情，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I apologize. Deep down, I felt that it was annoying for adventurers to talk to me. Now, I'll ask you first.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
抱歉。内心深处，我觉得冒险者来找我聊天有点烦人。现在，我先问问你。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
If you ever go through something similar, please let me know. I'm begging you.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
如果你以后遇到类似的事情，请告诉我。拜托了。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达汇报并获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told him about Karoo and Asudem.
scripts.translation: 向他讲述了卡鲁和阿苏德姆的事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Puhahaha I think you came to see the place where Hyung-nim and sister-in-law are dating.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
噗哈哈，我想你是来看哥哥和嫂子约会的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Oh my gosh.. that place is where my brother and sister-in-law often went on dates.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
天哪...那个地方是我哥哥和嫂子经常去约会的地方。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
My brother might think it's a secret place only he knows, but it's a place everyone in the village knows.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我哥哥可能觉得那是只有他知道的秘密地点，但村里的人都知道那里。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's quite a popular spot among village lovers. It's quiet and a good place for a date.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
那里是村里情侣们很喜欢的地方。那里很安静，是个约会的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Recently, I haven't had much to laugh about because of various things, but thanks to you, I laughed out loud. I look forward to the next story.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
最近因为各种事情，我没什么可笑的，但多亏了你，我开怀大笑。期待你的下一个故事。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达汇报并获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about who was painting murals in the cave.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达讲述了是谁在洞穴里画壁画。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Have you ever met me when I was painting the mural? I don't remember, but...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你见过我画壁画的时候吗？我不记得了，但是...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I think I can tell you why I painted the mural.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我想我可以告诉你我为什么画那幅壁画。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's not much of a secret, but each of my brothers has a mysterious ability.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
这不算什么秘密，我的每个兄弟都有神秘的能力。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
In the case of Karoo-hyung, he has the ability to see accurately even from a distance..
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
以卡鲁哥哥为例，他拥有从远处也能准确看清事物的能力...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Maknae Maru has an excellent memory that never forgets what she has seen and the ability to read her opponent's mind..
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
小妹妹玛鲁拥有过目不忘的惊人记忆力，还能读懂对手的心思...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I'm not always correct, but I can see into the future. Ah! I have more abilities than that.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
虽然我不一定总是对的，但我能预见未来。啊！我拥有的能力远不止这些。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I can see people's good and evil energy. In the case of adventurers...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我能看到人们身上的善与恶的气息。至于冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I can feel the good energy that can't be touched. That's why I feel more bitter.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我能感受到那种无法触及的善意。正因如此，我感到更加苦涩。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Coming back to the original story, the reason I'm painting the mural is because one day I dreamed of a village burning down.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
回到正题，我画这幅壁画是因为有一天我梦见村庄被烧毁了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Many monsters have come to town and people are crying out in pain because of it...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
许多魔物涌入了城镇，人们因痛苦而哀嚎...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
After the hellish dream, I saw myself recording the day's events on a mural in a cave.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
在那场噩梦之后，我看见自己正在洞穴的壁画上记录那天的事件。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Haha, don't worry too much. The dream hasn't happened yet.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
哈哈，别太担心。那个梦还没有成真。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Do you know? If I paint the mural in advance, will the future I saw in my dream change?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你知道吗？如果我提前画好这幅壁画，我在梦中看到的未来就会改变吗？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
An adventurer I haven't seen in my dreams is helping us, so I'm sure we can change it.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
有一位我在梦中未曾见过的冒险者在帮助我们，我相信我们一定能改变它。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达汇报并获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about Mao, who was training alone.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达讲述了独自训练的毛。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Mao guy... you've been thinking about a lot of things.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
毛这家伙...你最近想了很多事吧。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Brother Karu lives separately from his sister-in-law, and we still live together, but I don't think he cared too much about his sister.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
哥哥卡鲁和嫂子分开住，而我们还住在一起，但我觉得他并不太在意他的妹妹。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's said that I lost my mind after having a painful dream, but somehow my anxiety...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
据说我在做了痛苦的梦后精神失常了，但不知为何我的焦虑...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Looks like he's been infested with Mao. Maybe because of his abilities, he's often swayed by other people's emotions...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
看来他被毛的情绪侵扰了。也许是因为他的能力，他常常被他人的情绪所左右...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
He... training to become stronger... even if he doesn't become stronger... he's still enough...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
他...为了变强而训练...即使他无法变强...他也已经足够好了...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Thank you. Thanks to you, I found out about Mao's troubles.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
谢谢你。多亏了你，我才得知了毛的烦恼。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达汇报并获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about someone who was taking something from the cave.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达讲述了有人从洞穴里拿走东西的事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You saw that too. I think we've talked about it before. In my dream, I saw monsters coming into town.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你也看到了。我想我们之前谈过。在我的梦里，我看见魔物涌入了城镇。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
And in preparation for that time, the village warriors evacuated the elderly and weak to this place, and they stored supplies here and there in the cave.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
为了应对那一刻，村庄的战士们将老人和体弱者疏散到了这里，并将物资分散存放在洞穴各处。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
These are literally emergency items. It would be perfect if they were not used, but...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
这些是真正的应急物资。如果它们能一直不被使用，那就最好了，但是...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You don't know how the world works. If you find something, just ignore it.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你不懂这个世界的运作方式。如果你发现了什么，就假装没看见吧。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达汇报并获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of meeting the villagers and the village chief.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达讲述了遇见村民和村长的故事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You really came to see what happened a while ago. It wasn't as much damage as you saw in your dream, but it was a lot of damage.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你竟然真的去看了之前发生的事。虽然不像你在梦里看到的那样严重，但损失依然很大。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
When I think of that day, my heart hurts. All of a sudden, when my brothers were away...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
每当想起那一天，我的心就隐隐作痛。突然之间，当我的兄弟们不在的时候...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Still, the village chief, the best elder in the village, seems to have suffered less damage because he was calm. Thanks for the story.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
不过，村长，村里最年长的长老，似乎因为保持冷静而受到的伤害较小。谢谢你告诉我这些。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达汇报并获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of meeting the brothers who ran somewhere in a hurry.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达讲述了遇见匆忙离去的兄弟们的故事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You must have seen the day my brothers and I came back from hunting. There was a big disaster in the village and it was the next day.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你一定看到了我和兄弟们狩猎归来后的那一天。村里发生了大灾难，而那是第二天。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Kuh.. If me and my brothers hadn't emptied the village... the people wouldn't have been taken by the monsters...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
咳...如果我和兄弟们没有清空村庄...人们就不会被魔物带走...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
If so... my sister-in-law also...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
如果是那样...我的弟媳也会...

scripts.text: It's not your fault.
scripts.translation: 这不是你的错。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I know. It's not because of me and my brothers.. but.. that day.. we.. .. .. it's just a pity
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我知道。这不是我和兄弟们的错...但是...那一天...我们... ... ...真可惜

scripts.text: You'd better calm down first.
scripts.translation: 你先冷静一下。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You've shown me, adventurer, something I wouldn't have seen. I'm just here to tell you what I remember...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
冒险者，你让我看到了我未曾见过的景象。我只是在这里告诉你我所记得的...

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达汇报并获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of seeing Karu and Asudem.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达讲述了看见卡鲁和阿苏德姆的故事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ka.. Karu hyungnim.. hyungnim
That's the reason why you shut yourself up in the west cave.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
卡...卡鲁兄长...兄长
这就是你把自己关在西边洞穴里的原因。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I feel resentful of myself for not being able to help with the village defense.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我对自己感到怨恨，因为无法帮助村庄防御。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Your heart... I can't even imagine your sister-in-law's... whoo... your sorrow...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你的心...我甚至无法想象你的弟媳的...呜...你的悲伤...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
When the situation here is sorted out, I will look for my older brother. He must be alone in pain and sorrow.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
等这里的情况稳定下来，我会去找我的兄长。他一定正独自承受着痛苦和悲伤。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
My heart hurts like this too, but if you know the youngest who struggles because of his abilities... I'll have to prepare. Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我的心也这样痛着，但如果你知道那个因自身能力而挣扎的弟弟...我必须做好准备。谢谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达汇报并获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about stories of unknown people.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达讲述了关于陌生人的故事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It sounds like a conversation between a Wootan or Megalith monster targeting the village.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
听起来像是乌坦或邪恶摩艾魔物在针对村庄的对话。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Follow a strong leader? Recently, I felt that the movements of these guys are disturbingly orderly...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
追随一个强大的首领？最近，我觉得这些家伙的行动异常有序...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It seems that a monster has appeared to lead them.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
看来是出现了某种魔物在领导它们。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's embarrassing. Even now, all we can do is block it.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
真是惭愧。到现在为止，我们只能进行阻挡。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
This is not the time to be sad. We need to build more defenses and take other measures.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
现在不是悲伤的时候。我们需要建立更多的防御措施，并采取其他手段。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
A strong leader is also a problem... but a power that has been handed down as a legend? This is a story I've never heard of before.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
强大的首领也是个问题...但作为传说流传下来的力量？这是我从未听说过的故事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I'm guessing this is the reason why the monsters are attacking the village, but I'll have to tell the chief and investigate.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我猜测这就是魔物袭击村庄的原因，但我必须告诉首领并进行调查。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
The story you just told me was really helpful. Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你刚才告诉我的故事真的很有帮助。谢谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达汇报并获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's a situation where even one request is regrettable, but {0}... really.
You worked hard.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
即使只有一个请求也令人遗憾，但{0}...真的。
辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Each and every request is precious. Thank you again and again.
You worked hard.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
每一个请求都很珍贵。再次感谢。
辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Is there no request here?
scripts.translation: 这里没有请求吗？

scripts.text: What is this cave?
scripts.translation: 这个洞穴是什么？

scripts.text: Why are monsters invading?
scripts.translation: 为什么魔物会入侵？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
For quests that are recruiting in town, there is a separate request board.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
对于在城镇招募的任务，有单独的任务板。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ah! Watch your mind. The location is in the middle of the battlefield, so I installed it in the corner for safety reasons.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
啊！注意你的言行。位置在战场中央，为了安全起见，我把它安装在角落里了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
There are cases where you cannot complete a request on the bulletin board right away, but there is no specific time limit, so don't be in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
有时候你可能无法立即完成公告板上的请求，但没有具体的时间限制，所以不用着急。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Adventurer, you are really curious about everything.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
冒险者，你真的对一切都很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
The Luanda Caves are strategically the only way out north of town.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
卢安达洞穴在战略上是城镇以北唯一的出口。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
That's why we're defending against monster attacks here.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
所以我们在这里防御魔物的袭击。

scripts.text: Luanda Cave? Luanda?
scripts.translation: 卢安达洞穴？卢安达？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ah! Did you notice? Yes, my name is Luanda too. The village elders say...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
啊！你注意到了吗？是的，我的名字也叫卢安达。村里的长老们说...

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
The triplets are said to have been named Karu, Luanda, and Mao after the village caves.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
据说三胞胎的名字卡鲁、卢安达和毛，是以村里的洞穴命名的。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
My neighborhood friends teased me a bit when I was young, but I don't have any complaints about the name.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
小时候邻居朋友稍微取笑过我，但我对这个名字并不介意。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I heard they were named after the guardians of the village. I'm rather proud of them.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我听说他们是以村庄的守护者命名的。我对此感到相当自豪。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's very puzzling to us too. If we knew why, we'd have put everything away.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
这让我们也很困惑。如果我们知道原因，早就把一切收拾好了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
This isn't a town with plenty of food, and I don't think there's any particular reason for monsters to target it.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
这里并不是食物丰富的城镇，我认为魔物也没有特别针对这里的理由。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
But what can we do? We're just living here, and the monsters keep coming, so we have to live while blocking them.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
但我们能怎么办呢？我们就住在这里，魔物不断来袭，所以我们必须一边抵挡它们一边生活。

scripts.text: It's a bizarre shimmer that you're likely to be sucked into.
scripts.translation: 这是一种奇异的闪光，你很可能被吸进去。

scripts.text: It seems like a phenomenon that can't be ignored. I'll have to talk to Luanda, the head of defense.
scripts.translation: 这似乎是一种不能忽视的现象。我得去和防御负责人卢安达谈谈。

What's up? I'm a bit busy right now...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
什么事？我现在有点忙...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Ah, you're the one introduced by Raket. I've been waiting for you.
Can you show me your fishing rod?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
啊，你是拉凯特介绍来的。我一直在等你。
能给我看看你的鱼竿吗？

scripts.text: - Jerrymon began to examine the rod closely. -
scripts.translation: - 杰里蒙开始仔细检查鱼竿。 -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes, that's right... this substance is just that... to discover it again like this...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
是的，没错...这种物质就是那个...再次发现它...

scripts.text: What material are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你说的是什么材料？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Adventurer, do you know where the deepest part of the sea is?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
冒险者，你知道大海最深处的地方在哪里吗？

scripts.text: Well...??

[Jerrymon]
It is a place called the ^4d4dffTrench^000000. To put it simply, you can think of it as a deep cliff in the sea.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那个地方叫做^4d4dff海沟^000000。简单来说，你可以把它想象成海洋中深邃的悬崖。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
It is known that there are hundreds of different types of trenches in the world's oceans.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
已知世界海洋中存在数百种不同类型的海沟。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The widest and deepest known trench is the ^4d4dffBahia Trench^000000 near Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
已知最宽且最深的海沟是位于依斯鲁得岛附近的^4d4dff巴伊亚海沟^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
There are rare life forms at the bottom of the trench, and marine scientists like myself have shown great interest and have been exploring them.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
海沟底部存在着罕见的生物，像我这样的海洋科学家对此非常感兴趣，并一直在进行探索。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Though shallow trenches can be explored to some extent.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
虽然浅海沟可以在一定程度上被探索。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
But in the case of the Bahia Trench, scientists have calculated that scientifically, no life can exist because it is so incredibly deep.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
但就巴伊亚海沟而言，科学家计算出，由于它深不可测，从科学上讲那里不可能存在生命。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I recently found out that there is life in the Bahia Trench.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我最近发现巴伊亚海沟中确实存在生命。

scripts.text: How do you know that??
scripts.translation: 你怎么知道的？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
You can tell by the stone that contains my magic.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
通过蕴含我魔法的石头就能看出来。

scripts.text: A stone with magical power?
scripts.translation: 带有魔力的石头？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes, I'm a mage-turned-oceanographer. I learned magic for oceanography.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
是的，我是转行做海洋研究的魔法师。我学习魔法是为了进行海洋研究。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Enchant a large boulder and make it fall to the floor where the trench exists.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
给一块巨石施加魔法，让它沉入海沟底部。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The magic on the dropped stone is connected to me, so by measuring the distance, I can get a little idea of how deep it is and what's going on near the stone.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
沉入水中的石头上的魔法与我相连，通过测量距离，我就能大致了解那里的深度以及石头附近的情况。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
To tell you what I found out...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
让我告诉你我的发现...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The composition of normal sea water and deep sea water is almost the same. But the only difference is the deep sea of Bahia Trench.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
普通海水的成分与深海海水几乎相同。但唯一的例外是巴伊亚海沟的深海区域。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Should I say it's like water and oil? There's a section where they never mix.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
该怎么说呢，就像水和油一样？那里有一层它们永远不会混合的分界线。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
A strong boundary was formed where they meet each other, and it felt as if the deep seawater in that section was desperately blocking the seawater coming down from above.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
在它们相遇的地方形成了一道强烈的屏障，感觉那里的深海海水正在拼命阻挡从上方降下来的海水。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The water pressure is also much lower than that of normal seawater, so it is assumed that it has a favorable environment for life.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那里的水压也比普通海水低得多，因此推测那里拥有适合生命生存的环境。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
We call it ^4d4dffdeep seawater^000000
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我们称之为^4d4dff深海海水^000000

scripts.text: Is this gloss related to what you said?
scripts.translation: 这种光泽与你刚才说的那件事有关吗？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes! That's right!!
We only identified the existence of Abyssal Seawater deep in the Bahia Trench, and it was very difficult to obtain samples. This fishing rod has a lot of Abyssal Seawater on it...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
没错！就是这样！！
我们只在巴伊亚海沟深处确认了深渊海水的存在，而且很难获取样本。这根鱼竿上沾了很多深渊海水...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Could you leave this fishing rod with me? I think I can figure something out if I extract this sea water and turn it into essence.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
能把这根鱼竿留给我吗？我觉得如果提取出这些海水并制成精华，应该能发现些什么。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Oh, and I heard that the fishing rod was found today. Can I ask you to check if there is another floating substance in the nearby sea?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
哦对了，我听说这根鱼竿是今天被发现的。能请你检查一下附近海域是否还有漂浮物吗？

scripts.text: Okay, I'll be back.
scripts.translation: 好的，我马上回来。

scripts.text: I'm a bit busy right now...
scripts.translation: 我现在有点忙...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please come back to me when you're done!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
忙完请回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes, thanks! I'll be waiting for you!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
好的，谢谢！我会在这里等你的！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
抱歉打扰你了，拜托了。我会在这里等你的。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
抱歉打扰你了，拜托了。我会在这里等你的。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Ah, welcome, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
啊，欢迎回来，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The investigation is going smoothly~
Hey, could you take a look at this?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
调查进展得很顺利~
嘿，你能看一下这个吗？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
See those two little water bottles here?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
看到这两个小水瓶了吗？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
One side is normal seawater, and the other side is seawater mixed with seawater from the abyss buried in fishing rods. I'll try mixing these two.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
一边是普通海水，另一边是混合了鱼竿上深渊海水的海水。我要试着把这两者混合起来。

scripts.text: - Jerrymon poured both waters into one bottle and began to shake them together. -
scripts.translation: - 杰里蒙将两种水倒入同一个瓶子中，开始摇晃混合。 -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Now, look. As I said before, they don't mix at all, do they?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
现在，看。就像我之前说的，它们完全不会混合，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
This... this!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
这...这！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
If you shake it like crazy!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
如果拼命摇晃的话！！

scripts.text: [Jerrymon] Wow!!!!!!
scripts.translation: [杰里蒙] 哇！！！！！！

scripts.text: [Jerrymon] Uwachachaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!!!
scripts.translation: [杰里蒙] 乌哇恰恰恰恰恰恰恰恰！！！！！！

scripts.text: [Jerrymon] Ahhhhhhh!!!!!!
scripts.translation: [杰里蒙] 啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊...

scripts.text: Oh, I'm going to catch someone, is it okay?
scripts.translation: 哦，我要去抓人了，可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Keep... Whoa... Whoa... OK now.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
停...哇...哇...好了。

scripts.text: - Looking into the bottle Jerrymon is holding, I can clearly see the shape of the vortex. -
scripts.translation: - 看着杰里蒙手中的瓶子，我能清晰地看到漩涡的形状。 -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Now, do you see this whirlpool!! This is the passage that connects to the bottom of the Bahia Trench!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
现在，你看到这个漩涡了吗！！这是通往巴西亚海沟底部的通道！

scripts.text: ??? Isn't that just a whirlpool created by shaking it?
scripts.translation: ??? 那不就是摇晃产生的漩涡吗？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
No. This is the stone that contains my magical power. Let's look at it.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
不。这是蕴含我魔力的石头。让我们来看看。

scripts.text: - Jerrymon put a glowing stone into the bottle. The glowing stone was sucked into the whirlpool inside the bottle and disappeared without a trace! -
scripts.translation: - 杰里蒙将发光的石头放入瓶中。发光的石头被瓶中的漩涡吸入，消失得无影无踪！ -

scripts.text: No, how could it be?
scripts.translation: 不，怎么可能？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Did I ever tell you that the stone that contains my magic can measure the distance to me?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我有没有告诉过你，蕴含我魔力的石头可以测量与我之间的距离？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
It feels the same as the last time I threw a pebble into the Bahia Trench..
If you follow this whirlpool, you may be able to find the owner of the fishing rod.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
感觉和我上次往巴西亚海沟里扔石子时一样。
如果顺着这个漩涡走，也许能找到那根钓竿的主人。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The problem is... the amount of essence on a fishing rod can't make a whirlpool large enough for a person to fit in.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
问题是...钓竿上的精华量不足以产生一个能容纳人的漩涡。

scripts.text: Is this amount okay?
scripts.translation: 这个量够吗？

scripts.text: - Showed the ^4d4dff{0}^000000 received from Gein to Jerrymon. -
scripts.translation: - 向杰里蒙展示了从盖因那里获得的 ^4d4dff{0}^000000。 -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Oh, just in case, I actually found it!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
哦，刚好够用，我找到了！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
With this amount, I think I can create a vortex of fissures that normal people can enter. You can pass it to me.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
用这个量，我觉得可以制造出一个普通人也能进入的裂隙漩涡。你可以把它交给我。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The place is too small to do this much here, so let's do it in Izlude. In order to get help from your friends.
Then see you in Izlude!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
这里地方太小，没法施展这么大的法术，我们去依斯鲁得岛吧。顺便也去寻求你朋友们的帮助。
那么，依斯鲁得岛见！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Then let's meet in Izlude!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那么，依斯鲁得岛见！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
抱歉打扰你了，拜托了。我会在这里等你的。

scripts.text:
[Sirood]
Thank you very much, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[西鲁德]
非常感谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Sirood]
I thought I'd never come back...
scripts.translation:
[西鲁德]
我本以为再也回不来了...

scripts.text:
[Soup]
Hello, my name is Soup, a friend of Sirood who is missing.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
你好，我叫汤，是西鲁德失踪的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
The four of us, Sirood, Raket, Gein, and I often enjoyed fishing.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
我们四个，西鲁德、拉凯特、盖因和我，经常一起钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
That windy day... I had been feeling very guilty for not stopping Sirood from going fishing.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
那个刮风的日子...我一直很自责，没有阻止西鲁德去钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
When I heard that Sirood's fishing pole was found, I jumped out.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
当我听说找到了西鲁德的鱼竿时，我一下子跳了起来。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
You must have a clue about something?
scripts.translation:
[汤]
你一定知道些什么线索吧？

scripts.text:
[Soup]
I did my best.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
我已经尽力了。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
Should Sirood come back safely?
scripts.translation:
[汤]
希望西鲁德能平安归来。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
Sirood is back with us.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
西鲁德回来了。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
Thanks to you, adventurer. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
谢谢你，冒险者。非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
It's been exactly 3 months since Sirood went missing.
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
西鲁德失踪已经整整三个月了。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Sirood's fishing rod was found.
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
找到了西鲁德的鱼竿。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
I felt that way.
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
我有这种感觉。

scripts.text: What do you think?
scripts.translation: 你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Why is this only discovered now, isn't this a message from someone?
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
为什么现在才发现？这难道不是某人留下的信息吗？

scripts.text: Looking at it, it doesn't make sense.
scripts.translation: 看起来毫无道理。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Ha... It's just my delusion. I especially miss that child today.
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
哈...只是我的错觉罢了。今天格外想念那个孩子。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Heh heh... It's so hard to use all your strength...
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
呵呵...用尽全力真是不容易...

scripts.text:
[Raket]
But for Sirood's sake...
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
但为了西鲁德...

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Thank you so much!!
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
非常感谢！！

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Now you can fish with Sirood again.
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
现在你可以和西鲁德一起钓鱼了。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
I'm so glad...
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
真高兴...

scripts.text:
You have too many items.
Please clean up your items and try again.
scripts.translation:
您的物品栏已满。
请整理物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Haha... why did this only get discovered now??
It's impossible, this is...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
哈哈...为什么现在才发现这个？？
这不可能，这是...

scripts.text: - I feel serious anguish from this person. Let's come back after I've become level 140. -
scripts.translation: - 我感受到这个人深深的痛苦。等我升到140级再回来吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Haha...why did this only get discovered now??
It's impossible, this is...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
哈哈...为什么现在才发现这个？？
这不可能，这是...

scripts.text: Do you have any concerns?
scripts.translation: 你有什么顾虑吗？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Oh, hello...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
哦，你好...

scripts.text: - He is very fidgety with a fishing pole in his hand. It doesn't look like he's out fishing. -
scripts.translation: - 他手里拿着钓竿，坐立不安。看起来不像是出来钓鱼的。 -

scripts.text: [Gein] This fishing rod belongs to my friend Sirood who went missing three months ago. I found something!!!
scripts.translation: [盖因] 这根钓竿属于我三个月前失踪的朋友西鲁德。我发现了什么！！！

scripts.text: Disappeared?
scripts.translation: 失踪了？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Yes... Sirood is a fishing fanatic and came here to fish whenever he had a chance.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
是的...西鲁德是个钓鱼狂人，只要有空就会来这里钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Influenced by Sirood, we also fell in love with fishing, and the four of us often had a good time.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
受西鲁德的影响，我们也爱上了钓鱼，我们四个经常一起度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Sirood's passion for fishing was to the point that he invited us to go fishing even in the rain and wind.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
西鲁德对钓鱼的热情到了极点，甚至邀请我们在风雨天也去钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
The day Sirood went missing was exactly the same rainy and windy day. I put on my raincoat and went to go fishing.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
西鲁德失踪的那天，正好也是这样一个风雨交加的日子。我穿上雨衣，准备去钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
We were invited to go out together, but they all declined.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
我们被邀请一起出去，但大家都拒绝了。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Sirood went fishing alone and we haven't seen him since...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
西鲁德独自去钓鱼，从那以后我们就再也没见过他...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
I should have stopped you from leaving...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
我应该拦住你离开的...

scripts.text: - Gein started talking again after wiping away tears for a moment. -
scripts.translation: - 盖因擦去眼泪后，又开始说话了。 -

scripts.text:
[Gein]
The news of Sirood's disappearance immediately spread throughout Izlude and a large-scale search was conducted with a lot of time and manpower invested, but the search ended without finding any clues.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
西鲁德失踪的消息很快传遍了依斯鲁得岛，投入了大量时间和人力进行大规模搜索，但搜索最终没有发现任何线索。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
After that, we got together and ran everywhere to find Sirood, but there was no result, and we were about to give up.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
之后，我们聚在一起到处寻找西鲁德，但毫无结果，我们几乎要放弃了。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
But just now!!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
但是就在刚才！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
After 3 months!!!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
在三个月之后！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Sirood's fishing pole has risen above sea level. His item was nowhere to be found during the search!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
西鲁德的钓竿浮出了海面。之前的搜索中完全没有发现他的任何物品！

scripts.text: Now, calm down... Are you sure it's Sirood's fishing rod?
scripts.translation: 现在，冷静一下...你确定那是西鲁德的钓竿吗？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Yes, I'm sure! It's the fishing rod I've always seen.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
是的，我确定！那就是我一直看到的那根钓竿。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
This fishing rod was made by Sirood himself, so it is the only one. You can see the initials on the handle here, S.R.D!!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
这根钓竿是西鲁德亲手制作的，所以是独一无二的。你可以看到手柄上刻着缩写，S.R.D！！

scripts.text: Oh, then why now...
scripts.translation: 噢，那为什么是现在...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
I'm so surprised and shocked right now that I don't know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
我现在太惊讶和震惊了，都不知道该怎么办。

scripts.text: - But looking closely at the fishing rod, I feel something different. This wooden fishing rod has been submerged in water for 3 months, but it still looks the same, and I can see a bit of shiny gloss... -
scripts.translation: - 但仔细看着那根钓竿，我感到有些不同。这根木制钓竿在水中浸泡了三个月，但看起来依然如新，甚至还能看到一点光泽... -

scripts.text: Isn't this fishing rod a bit strange over there?
scripts.translation: 这根钓竿那里有点奇怪？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Strange, what is it?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
奇怪？哪里奇怪？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Uh...

[Gein]
Uh.....??

[Gein]
It's been submerged in water for 3 months... but it hasn't corroded at all. It's completely fine??
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
它在水中浸泡了三个月...但完全没有腐蚀。完好无损？？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Hmm... And it seems to have a subtle glow... It seems like the fishing rod is coated?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
嗯...而且似乎有一种微弱的光芒...看起来像是钓竿被什么东西包裹着？

scripts.text: -The person who seemed to be Gein's friend who was listening to the story opened his mouth. -
scripts.translation: - 那个似乎是盖因的朋友，一直在听故事的人开了口。 -

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Where is it, I want to see it!! What's wrong??
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
在哪里，我想看看！！怎么了？？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
This fishing rod... It was submerged in the water for 3 months, but it was found in its original form, or worse, in a state of disrepair.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
这根钓竿...它在水中浸泡了三个月，但被发现时依然保持原样，甚至可以说比之前更完好。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
啧...

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Um...
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
嗯...

scripts.text: - Raket looked intently at his fishing pole, then answered Gein. -
scripts.translation: - 拉凯特盯着他的钓竿看了一会儿，然后回答盖因。 -

scripts.text:
[Raket]
I'm not sure either?
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
我也不太确定？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Certainly!! I don't know, but would you?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
当然！！我不知道，但你会知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Ummm... but I know someone who might know a little about this rod.
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
嗯...不过我认识一个人，他可能对这根钓竿了解一些。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Who??
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
是谁？？

scripts.text: Who?
scripts.translation: 谁？

scripts.text: [Raket] His name is Jerrymon, a marine scientist. I've met my father a few times. I know you are in the East Library of Prontera.
scripts.translation: [拉凯特] 他叫杰里蒙，是一位海洋科学家。我见过我父亲几次。我知道你在普隆德拉的东图书馆。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Ah, ah... then... hey adventurer!! I'm sorry for the first meeting, but can I ask you a favor?? We can't get out of here in Izlude...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
啊，啊...那么...嘿，冒险者！！初次见面请多关照，能请你帮个忙吗？？我们在依斯鲁得岛出不去...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Please go see Jerrymon and show him this fishing rod...even if it's trivial...I hope he has some information..
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
请去找杰里蒙看看，给他看看这根钓竿...即使只是小事...希望他能提供一些信息..

scripts.text: Okay. Let's go.
scripts.translation: 好的。我们走吧。

scripts.text: Sorry. I'm a bit busy right now...
scripts.translation: 抱歉。我现在有点忙...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
No... are you sure?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
不...你确定吗？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Are you turning around after hearing about this heartbreaking story and mysterious clue...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
听完这个令人心碎的故事和神秘的线索，你就要转身离开吗...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Ugh... Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
啧...谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
^4d4dffJerrymon^000000 should still be at the <NAVI>[East Library]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
^4d4dff杰里蒙^000000应该还在普隆德拉的<NAVI>[东图书馆]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Now, I'll give you the fishing rod, a keepsake from Sirood. Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
现在，我把这根钓竿交给你，这是西鲁德的纪念品。谢谢你...

scripts.text:
[Raket]
What??? It's a keepsake!! You don't even know if Sirood is alive or dead!!
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
什么？？那是纪念品！！你甚至不知道西鲁德是死是活！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Uhhh... yes I made a mistake, this is the fishing rod Sirood left behind. Please take good care of it.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
呃...是的，我搞错了，这是西鲁德留下的钓竿。请好好保管它。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
I'll tell Jerrymon about the contents in advance through my father!
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
我会通过我父亲提前告诉杰里蒙里面的内容！

scripts.text:
[Gein & Raket & Soup]
Thank you!!!
scripts.translation:
[盖因、拉凯特与汤]
谢谢！！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
You can go to Prontera's <NAVI>[East Library]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI> as Raket told you.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
你可以像拉凯特说的那样，去普隆德拉的<NAVI>[东图书馆]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Take care of yourself!! I hope there is even the smallest clue...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
请多保重！！希望哪怕只有一点点线索也好...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Ah, you're here!!!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
啊，你来了！！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Do you have any information about Sirood?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
你有关于西鲁德的消息吗？

scripts.text: - I relayed what I heard from Jerrymon. -
scripts.translation: - 我转述了从杰里蒙那里听到的内容。 -

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Ah... I see, I've never heard of a trench before.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
啊...原来如此，我以前从未听说过什么海沟。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
I can't believe there's such a big and deep trench near Izlude...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
真不敢相信，依斯鲁得岛附近竟然有这么大、这么深的海沟...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Oh, by the way, is there anything else you need for coming back here?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
对了，你回来这里还需要其他什么东西吗？

scripts.text: I was wondering if there was anything else found besides the fishing rod.
scripts.translation: 我想问问除了钓竿之外，是否还发现了其他东西。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Oh right!!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
啊，对了！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
It's a chunk scooped up with a landing net near where the fishing rod was found.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
是在发现钓竿的地方附近，用抄网捞上来的一块东西。

scripts.text:
- This lump is what Jerrymon said.
^4d4dffIt must be the essence of the abyss^000000. -
scripts.translation:
- 这就是杰里蒙所说的那个东西。
^4d4dff它一定是深渊的精华^000000。 -

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Something shiny and has the same feeling of Sirood's fishing rod, so I secured it for now.
Could this nugget help?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
它闪闪发光，和西鲁德的钓竿给人的感觉一样，所以我先把它保管起来了。
这块东西会有帮助吗？

scripts.text: Thanks, that would be a great help.
scripts.translation: 谢谢，这会很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Are you going back to Jerrymon? Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
你要回杰里蒙那里吗？请小心。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
I hope Sirood will appear in front of us intact, just as the fishing rod appeared intact...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
希望西鲁德能像钓竿那样完好无损地出现在我们面前...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Please let me know if you have any new information!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
如果你有任何新消息，请告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Heh...heh...Hello adventurer, heh...heh... I'm so tired I can't move...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
嘿...嘿...你好冒险者，嘿...嘿...我累得动不了了...

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
谢谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
To be able to meet Sirood again is like a dream.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
能再次见到西鲁德，简直像做梦一样。

scripts.text:
You have too many items.
Please clean up your items and try again.
scripts.translation:
您的物品栏已满。
请整理物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Wow... this purple sea... it's fantastic!!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
哇...这片紫色的海洋...太壮观了！！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
It's so amazing that we can breathe without gills, there's no sea pressure, and even marine life that I've never seen before...!!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
不用鳃就能呼吸，没有海水压力，甚至还有我从未见过的海洋生物...！！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
There's more than one or two things to look into, I'll be busy.
Wow... so exciting!!! I think this is the most thrilling moment in my 14 years as an oceanographer!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
要研究的东西太多了，我会很忙的。
哇...太令人兴奋了！！！我想这是我14年海洋学家生涯中最激动人心的时刻！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Lululala~~~
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
啦啦啦~~~

scripts.text: Oh hey, I'm here to find Sirood...
scripts.translation: 哦，我是来找西鲁德的...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Ah, ah... that, right? That should take precedence.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
啊，啊...对，没错。那件事应该优先处理。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
In order to bring Sirood back ashore, we need an additional ^4d4dff{0}^000000. The question is how to get it...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
为了把西鲁德带回陆地，我们需要额外的^4d4dff{0}^000000。问题是该如何获取...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I've been watching the deep sea creatures here, and I've seen some of them glow with the essence of the abyss.
And they seem to threaten us sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我一直在观察这里的深海生物，发现有些会散发出深渊精华的光芒。
而且它们有时会威胁到我们。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
In that sense, could you handle some of the deep sea creatures? Maybe we can get ^4d4dff{0}^000000 from them.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
从这个角度看，你能处理一些深海生物吗？也许我们可以从它们身上获得^4d4dff{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please take out 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000, and ^4d4dff{2}^000000.
Okay
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: I'll do it next time
scripts.translation: 我下次再来

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes yes~ I'll be waiting for you here!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
好的好的~我会在这里等你的！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes yes~ I'll be waiting for you here!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
好的好的~我会在这里等你的！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please take out 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000, and ^4d4dff{2}^000000.

[Jerrymon]
I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我会在这里等你的。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Thank you for your hard work, you also brought ^4d4dff{0}^000000!! As expected, my prediction was correct.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
辛苦你了，你还带来了^4d4dff{0}^000000！！正如我所预测的那样。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
It looks like we only need about 10 ^4d4dff{0}^000000 to send Sirood back ashore.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
看来只需要大约10个^4d4dff{0}^000000就能把西鲁德带回陆地了。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
If you collect them, I'll create a whirlpool for you.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
如果你收集好了，我会为你制造一个漩涡。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Oh, and this is a stone I found while researching. I've been keeping it because it looks like something that could be used by adventurers, so please take it.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
哦，这是我研究时捡到的一块石头。我觉得它可能对冒险者有用，所以一直留着，请收下吧。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那么，请小心！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please bring ^4d4dff10 {0}^000000.

[Jerrymon]
I'd like to save it myself, but as you can see I'm weak, heck.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我想自己救他，但你也看到了，我很弱，唉。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Thank you for your hard work!! You brought 10 ^4d4dff{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
辛苦你了！！你带来了10个^4d4dff{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Would you like to go ashore now?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
您现在想上岸吗？

scripts.text: Go ashore
scripts.translation: 上岸

scripts.text: Not going up now
scripts.translation: 现在不上岸

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Talk to me when you're ready to go ashore!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
准备好上岸时请告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I found this again while waiting for adventurer. Please accept it!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
在等待冒险者时我又发现了这个。请收下！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Okay, let's condense this...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
好，让我们凝聚一下...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Huh...!!

[Jerrymon]
Now, Adventurer and Sirood!! Can you help me?? Ehhh!!!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
现在，冒险者和西鲁德！！能帮帮我吗？？啊啊啊！！

scripts.text: - A huge whirlpool was created in front of Jerrymon! -
scripts.translation: - 杰里蒙面前出现了一个巨大的漩涡！ -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Then I'll cross first!!! Follow me carefully!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那我先过去！！！请小心跟随我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I have everything I need for today's survey, thank you!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我已经收集齐了今天调查所需的一切，谢谢！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Looks like you've finished your business. Would you like to move to Izlude?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
看来您办完事了。您想去依斯鲁得岛吗？

scripts.text: Move
scripts.translation: 前往

scripts.text: Do not move
scripts.translation: 不要移动

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please let me know if you need any help!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
如果您需要帮助，请告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Okay, huh!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
好的，嗯！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm going to cross~~ Ah!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我要过去了~~ 啊！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Hello, research is going well.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
你好，研究进展顺利。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
If we do well, we might be able to make the vortex linking here and Izlude last forever!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
如果顺利的话，我们也许能让连接这里和依斯鲁得岛的漩涡永远存在！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
So, can you help me a bit more?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那么，你能再帮我一点忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I need more ^4d4dff{0}^000000, and I'd like you to take care of the ^4d4dffDeep Sea Creatures^000000 that get in the way of my research.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我还需要更多^4d4dff{0}^000000，另外请帮我处理一下妨碍我研究的^4d4dff深海生物^000000。

scripts.text: Okay
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: I'll do it next time
scripts.translation: 我下次再来

scripts.text: I want to go back to Izlude
scripts.translation: 我想回依斯鲁得岛

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Thanks!! Can you do something for me?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
谢谢！！能帮我做点事吗？

scripts.text: Next time.
scripts.translation: 下次吧

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
^4d4dff{0}^000000 can be obtained from all the deep sea creatures here.
I need 10 right now.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
^4d4dff{0}^000000可以从这里所有的深海生物身上获得。
我现在需要10个。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Then take care of yourself~~!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那么请多保重~~！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I need 10 ^4d4dff{0}^000000.

[Jerrymon]
Come back to me when you've collected all the essences!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
收集齐所有的精华后回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
You've collected all the {0}!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
你收集齐了所有的{0}！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Thank you, I'll put it to good use in my research.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
谢谢你，我会好好用在研究上的。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please kill 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000 and ^4d4dff{2}^000000 that roam around here.

[Jerrymon]
Then take care of yourself~~!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那么请多保重~~！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please kill 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000, and ^4d4dff{2}^000000.

[Jerrymon]
You've finished dealing with all the deep sea creatures, thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
你处理完了所有的深海生物，谢谢你的辛苦工作。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'll get back to you if I need help. Thanks!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
如果还需要帮忙我会再联系你的。谢谢！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The only person I can ask for is you...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我能求助的人只有你...

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Feel free to tell me if you change your mind!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
如果你改变主意了，请随时告诉我！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'll be staying here for a while, so let me know if you change your mind!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我会在这里待一段时间，如果你改变主意了请告诉我！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Okay, huh!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
好的，嗯！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm going to cross~~ Ah!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我要过去了~~ 啊！！

scripts.text:
[???]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[简]
你好。

scripts.text: Are you Sirood?
scripts.translation: 你是西鲁德吗？

scripts.text:
[Jane]
No, my name is Jane.
scripts.translation:
[简]
不，我叫简。

scripts.text:
[Jane]
Sirood...?
I think I've heard that name somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[简]
西鲁德...？
我好像在哪里听过这个名字...

scripts.text:
[Jane]
Hello, it looks like you've been here a while...
scripts.translation:
[简]
你好，看起来你已经在这里待了一会儿了...

scripts.text:
[Jane]
How do you like it? Isn't this a pretty charming place too?
scripts.translation:
[简]
感觉如何？这里也很迷人吧？

scripts.text:
[Jane]
I should go back to my hometown...
scripts.translation:
[简]
我该回我的家乡了...

scripts.text:
[???]
You said you were looking for someone named Sirood?
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
你说过你在找一个叫西鲁德的人？

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
My name is Sunrin.
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
我叫孙琳。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
Sirood... ah, I think I know who it is.
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
西鲁德...啊，我想我知道是谁了。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
Go all the way to the left, and you'll find him.
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
一直往左走，就能找到他。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
Then have a nice day today!!
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
All the people here are immigrants and settlers.
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
这里的人都是移民和定居者。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
As you can see, there are traces of civilization in these depths, but everyone here was an outsider.
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
如你所见，这些深处也有文明的痕迹，但这里的人都是外来者。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
You'll get used to it soon.
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
你很快就会习惯的。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
Sea monsters do attack from time to time, but that's about it...
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
海怪偶尔会袭击，但也就这样了...

scripts.text:
[Nick]
How is it? Is it worth living here?
scripts.translation:
[尼克]
感觉如何？值得在这里生活吗？

scripts.text:
[Nick]
It's deeper here than anywhere else, and it's amazing to be able to breathe freely.
I'm not sure how that works.
scripts.translation:
[尼克]
这里比别处更深，能自由呼吸真是不可思议。
我不太明白这是怎么回事。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Your strength isn't enough to cross to the lower levels.
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
你的力量不足以前往下层。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Please come back after you are at least level 180.
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
请至少达到180级后再来。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
If you go downstairs, you will run into some pretty vicious fish. Would that be alright?
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
如果你下楼，会遇到一些相当凶猛的鱼。这样可以吗？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: I'll come next time
scripts.translation: 下次再来

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Please talk to me again when you are ready to cross.
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
准备好通过时，请再和我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Then be careful.
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
那么请小心。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Hello, would you like to go upstairs again?
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
你好，你想再上楼吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Please talk to me again when you are ready to cross.
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
准备好通过时，请再和我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Then be careful.
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
那么请小心。

scripts.text:
You have too many items.
Please clean up your items and try again.
scripts.translation:
您的物品栏已满。
请整理物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Thank you for your hard work. Take a good rest today and visit us tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
感谢你的辛勤工作。今天好好休息，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Hello, Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
你好，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
I heard that there are many dangerous deep-sea creatures in the lower layer, but when I came here, they were more dangerous than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
我听说下层有很多危险的深海生物，但当我来到这里时，发现它们比我想象的还要危险。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Not too long ago, there was a lot of uproar when a creature from the lower layer came up to the upper layer.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
不久前，下层的一个生物爬到了上层，引起了很大的骚动。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
The population of deep sea creatures is increasing. Adventurer, may I ask for your help?
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
深海生物的数量正在增加。冒险者，能请你帮个忙吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Oops...
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Kena]
It would be dangerous if left unattended...
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
如果不加处理会很危险...

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Thank you, I'd appreciate it if you could help me defeat the deep sea creatures or fishmen.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
谢谢，如果你能帮我击败深海生物或鱼人，我会很感激的。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
你想做什么？

scripts.text: Next time.
scripts.translation: 下次吧

scripts.text:
[Kena]
I think this is enough for today, please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
我想今天到这里就够了，请明天再来。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Please kill 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000, and ^4d4dff{2}^000000.

[Kena]
These monsters are quite ferocious, so be very careful.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
这些魔物相当凶猛，请非常小心。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Please kill 10 of each.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
请各击杀10只。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
They've all been eliminated, thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
它们都被消灭了，谢谢你的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
If you have time, please come back tomorrow. I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
如果你有时间，请明天再来。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
I think this is enough for today, please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
我想今天到这里就够了，请明天再来。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Please take out 15 ^4d4dff{0}^000000 and ^4d4dff{1}^000000 each.

[Kena]
They are quite annoying, so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
它们相当讨厌，请小心。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Please take out 15 ^4d4dff{0}^000000 and ^4d4dff{1}^000000 each.

[Kena]
They've all been eliminated, thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
它们都被消灭了，谢谢你的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Please drop by tomorrow when the time is right. I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
请在合适的时候明天过来。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Oops...
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Kena]
It would be dangerous if left unattended...
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
如果不加处理会很危险...

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
We can't be like this...
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
我们不能这样下去...

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
But until an adventurer strong enough to get there...
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
但在有足够强大的冒险者能到达那里之前...

scripts.text: == This is a level 160 or higher quest ==
scripts.translation: == 这是一个160级或更高等级的任务 ==

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
Are you really in?
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
你真的要参加吗？

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
That's right. A lot of people said they saw it.
Since he said he was a ranger who injured his left arm, it can't be that he's the only friend he's ever seen.
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
没错。很多人都说看到了他。
既然他说自己是一名左臂受伤的游侠，那就不可能只有他一个朋友。

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
What should I do? If I get hurt like that, let alone search...
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
我该怎么办？如果我像那样受伤了，别说搜索了...

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
Oh, wait!
There adventurer, wait a minute!
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
哦，等等！
那位冒险者，请等一下！

scripts.text: Me?
scripts.translation: 我吗？

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
Have you been here in a while?
That's great. Here, we recently found a way to go deeper.
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
你最近来过这里吗？
太好了。看，我们最近发现了一条通往更深层的路。

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
Hey, what if I tell you that! And it's not my research, it's yours!
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
嘿，如果我告诉你呢！而且这不是我的研究，是你的！

scripts.text: Speak and sleep...
scripts.translation: 对话并休息...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're saying that to strangers?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你对陌生人说这种话？

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
That's right! Adventurer,
sorry, wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
没错！冒险者，
抱歉，请等一下。

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
What's up, I need to hire more people now.
It's not even a ruin, so how about going wild?
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
怎么了，我现在需要招募更多人。
这甚至算不上废墟，不如去野外看看？

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
Let's stop making mistakes all the time and leaving it to me to do the follow-up.
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
别再总是犯错，然后留给我来善后了。

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
An adventurer is waiting for you.
Let's chat later, huh?
Okay, so adventurer.
Your name is {0}?
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
有一位冒险者在等你。
我们稍后再聊，好吗？
好的，那么冒险者。
你的名字是{0}？

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
Yes, {0}.
I'll get to the point.
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
是的，{0}。
我直入正题。

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
I'm Mirko, that's Yolanda
And then one of the rangers, slightly injured, went into that newly discovered anthill I was talking about earlier. I think...
My goal right now is not exploration, I want you to rescue the Ranger and his friends.
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
我是米尔科，这是约兰达。
然后，一名受了轻伤的一名游侠，进入了我之前提到的那个新发现的蚁穴。我想...
我现在的目标不是探索，我希望你救出那名游侠和他的朋友们。

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
Ranger's name is Briashen...
The colleague Briashen spoke of was Khahris,
According to Briashen, he looks like a twin to her.
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
那名游侠的名字叫布里亚申...
布里亚申提到的同事叫卡赫里斯，
据布里亚申说，他看起来像她的双胞胎。

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
Once you find either one
I want you to bring me out.
A corpse is fine, please.
Call me back when you're ready
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
一旦你找到其中任何一个人，
我希望你把他带出来。
即使是尸体也没关系，拜托了。
准备好后再联系我

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
What's wrong...
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
怎么了...

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
If only I had been a little stronger...
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
要是我稍微强一点就好了...

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
Have you seen Briashen?
You're alive? I'm glad... why didn't you bring me out?
Ah...
...
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
你见到布里亚申了吗？
你还活着？太好了...为什么没把我带出来？
啊...
...

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
Try talking to Mirko again.
I think you're thinking the same thing as me.
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
再和米尔科谈谈吧。
我想你和我想的一样。

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
It would be nice if we could go too...
Take care of Briashen.
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
要是我们能一起去就好了...
照顾好布里亚申。

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
What a surprise!
Where did it come from?!
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
真是吓我一跳！
它从哪冒出来的？！

scripts.text: It bounced
scripts.translation: 它跳过来的

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
What?
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There were three people who looked like Khahris...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有三个长得像卡赫里斯的人...

scripts.text: == Explained everything to Mirko and Yolanda. ==
scripts.translation: == 向米尔科和约兰达解释了一切。 ==

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
All three disappeared in the middle of a conversation.
Besides, the last person you met was... Vitata?
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
三个人都在谈话中途消失了。
而且，你最后遇到的是...黑蚁？

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
Maybe... maybe..
Couldn't all three be the Khahris instead of the one who looked like him?
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
也许...也许...
那三个人都是卡赫里斯，而不是长得像他的人？

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
What?
If {0} was alone there, it could have been hallucinations too, right?
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
什么？
如果{0}当时是一个人，那也可能是幻觉，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
I heard Briaschen did that. Ants didn't attack me when I was with Khahris.
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
我听说布里亚申做过这种事。我和卡赫里斯在一起时，蚂蚁没有攻击我。

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
But at the end Maya...
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
但最后蚁后...

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
If that was the case?
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
如果是那样的话？

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
This is a hypothesis.
Khahris... was with Vitata, so the other ants obviously wouldn't touch it.
Aren't ants colonies?
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
这是一个假设。
卡赫里斯...和黑蚁在一起，所以其他蚂蚁显然不会碰它。
蚂蚁不是群居的吗？

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
But Maya is the ruler of dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
但蚁后是地牢的统治者。

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
Um...
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
If you can harm yourself...
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
如果你能伤害自己...

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
I might be able to touch it.
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
我可能就能碰到它。

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
Vitata's behavior is a threat to her status...
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
黑蚁的行为是对她地位的威胁...

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
!!
So what's really dangerous right now...
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
！！
所以现在真正危险的其实是...

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
{0}, now that's hypothetical, but now Briashen is really dangerous!
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
{0}，那只是假设，但现在布里亚申才是真正危险的！

scripts.text: Okay, I'll be back
scripts.translation: 好的，我马上回来

scripts.text: I need some time to get ready
scripts.translation: 我需要时间准备一下

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
It's urgent, so I'll ask you quickly!
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
情况紧急，我就长话短说了！

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
Please!
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
拜托了！

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
Please, {0}...
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
拜托了，{0}...

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
...

[Yolanda]
I'll be doing this research for a while.
It's not much. I'll do the money later.
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
我还会继续研究一段时间。
报酬不多，钱我之后再付。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
Have you seen Briashen yet?
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
你见过布里亚申了吗？

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
Not yet.
...I need to see what's there, too.
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
还没有。
...我也需要去看看那里有什么。

Steven brought it because he said he was looking for something salty to eat at home.
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
史蒂文带它回来，说是想找点咸咸的东西吃。

scripts.text:
[Acid]
The pay is so good compared to the job, and the delivery place is also a mine, so it was a bit suspicious...
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
报酬比工作好太多了，而且送货地点也是米内，所以有点可疑...

scripts.text:
[Acid]
I've been told that idiot is excited.
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
听说那个笨蛋很兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
What an idiot!
Thanks to you, I get hospital bills and your cough...
Oh... Come to think of it, you don't cough anymore, do you?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
真是个笨蛋！
多亏了你，我有了医院账单，还有你的咳嗽...
哦...说起来，你不咳嗽了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Acid]
Uh... is that so?
Come to think of it, I feel like I can breathe easier!
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
呃...是吗？
说起来，我觉得呼吸顺畅多了！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
No matter how many times I went to the hospital, there was no improvement...
Maybe it was just the bad air!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
不管去多少次医院，都没有好转...
也许只是空气不好！

scripts.text:
[Acid]
No, that's not important right now...
The doll we made is alive and moving!
They even tried to kidnap you!
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
不，现在这不是重点...
我们做的玩偶活过来了，还会动！
它们甚至试图绑架你！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Kidnapped... Come to think of it, I helped a man who was being chased by a terrific Teddy Bear on the way back.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
绑架...说起来，回来的路上，我帮了一个被可怕的泰迪熊追赶的男子。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
...I'm not the only one brought here, am I?
I guess I'll have to stay here and watch the situation.
Acid! You can go back to the village for now.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
...不只是我一个人被带到这里，对吧？
看来我得留在这里观察情况。
阿西德！你可以先回村庄了。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Thank you for helping me too.
I can't give you much, but I'll give you the rare ore I found earlier.
It might come in handy somewhere!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
谢谢你的帮助。
我没什么能给你的，但我会把之前发现的稀有矿石给你。
也许你在哪里用得上！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Get some rest
If you overdo it, you'll only ruin your health.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
好好休息
如果过度劳累，只会损害你的健康。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Ugh...
Where do these guys keep popping up?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
咳...
这些人到底是从哪里冒出来的？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
If you're familiar with combat, puppeteers who aren't familiar with combat won't find it easy to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
如果你熟悉战斗，不熟悉战斗的傀儡师就不容易从这里脱身了。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
For now, I'm also taking care of it, but I'm not good enough alone.
If you're not busy right now, help me defeat {0}, {1}, and {2}.
I think I'll be able to breathe a little more if I catch 10 of them.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
目前我也在负责处理，但仅凭我一人还不够。
如果你现在不忙，请帮我击败{0}、{1}和{2}。
我觉得只要抓到10只，我就能稍微安心一点了。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Okay...
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
好的...

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Then please help me defeat
10 {0}, {1}, and {2}!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
那么请帮我击败10只{0}、{1}和{2}！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
How are you?
How are things going with {0}, {1}, and {2}?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
你好吗？
{0}、{1}和{2}的情况怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Whoa...
Good job!
Are you feeling a little safer now?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
哇...
干得好！
现在感觉稍微安全一点了吗？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Can't you let me go?!
Let me go!
This sucks!!!!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
你不能放我走吗？！
放开我！
这太糟糕了！！！！

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear]
Oops!
Caught, I got caught!
Let's run!!!!
scripts.translation:
[泰迪熊]
哎呀！
被抓到了，我被抓到了！
快跑啊！！！！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Um hahahahahahahahaha!!!!
Listen, people!
Finally the day has come when we will rise again!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
嘿嘿哈哈哈哈哈！！！！
听着，人们！
我们再次崛起的日子终于到来了！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Forget the shameful past of being trapped in the dark and damp ground.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
忘掉被困在黑暗潮湿地下的耻辱过去吧。

scripts.text:
[??????]
This land!!!
This world!!!!
Until the day they are at our feet, us Nazarians!!!!
Will not stop the invasion!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
这片土地！！！
这个世界！！！！
直到它们臣服于我们纳扎里安脚下！！！！
入侵绝不会停止！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
Okay! A new body has arrived!
We will plant our holy core into the body that is only an empty shell!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安]
好！新的躯体到了！
我们将把神圣核心植入这具空壳之中！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Drivius! Come on get it!!!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
德里维乌斯！快把它拿来！！！

scripts.text:
[Drivius]
Yes!!! His Majesty is here!!!
scripts.translation:
[德里维乌斯]
是！！！陛下驾到！！！

scripts.text:
[Emperor of Nazarians]
Ha ha... look!
This bright and beautiful figure...
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安皇帝]
哈哈...看！
这明亮而美丽的躯体...

scripts.text:
[Emperor of Nazarians]
People!!!
Welcome!
Brave newly born soldiers!!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安皇帝]
人们！！！
欢迎！
勇敢的崭新士兵们！！！！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
Waaaaaaaa!!!!
Long live the Emperor!!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安]
哇啊啊啊啊！！！！
皇帝万岁！！！！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
Hooray!!! Hooray!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安]
万岁！！！万岁！！！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
Look at those dashing soldiers over there!!!
Awesome!!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安]
看那边那些帅气的士兵！！！
太棒了！！！！

scripts.text:
[Emperor of Nazarians]
The world will bow before the mighty power of the Nazarians!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安皇帝]
世界将在纳扎里安的强大力量面前俯首称臣！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
Waaaaaaaa!!!!
Long live the Emperor!!!!
Hooray!!! Hooray!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安]
哇啊啊啊啊！！！！
皇帝万岁！！！！
万岁！！！万岁！！！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Wait what's that?
Isn't that the doll we made?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
等等，那是什么？
那不是我们做的玩偶吗？

scripts.text:
[Acid]
I guess so?
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
应该是吧？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
It does not only look like that, it is the one we made!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
它不只是长得像，就是我们做的那个！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
It's the one who made a mess because you sewed wrong?? Yes!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
就是那个因为你缝错了而弄得一团糟的玩偶？没错！

scripts.text:
[Acid]
What a mess...
That one has its own cuteness point?
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
真是一团糟...
不过它也有自己的可爱之处？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
...cute horns...
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
...可爱的角...

scripts.text:
[Emperor of Nazarians]
Hmm...
Oops...
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安皇帝]
嗯...
哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Emperor of Nazarians]
It looks like a rat has lurked into the sacred assembly.
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安皇帝]
看来有一只老鼠溜进了神圣的集会。

scripts.text:
[Emperor of Nazarians]
Warriors of Nazarians!!!!
Punish the intruder!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安皇帝]
纳扎里安的战士们！！！！
惩罚这个入侵者！！！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
From our name!
We'll do it!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安]
为了我们的名字！
我们会做到的！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
Waaaaaaa!!!
Punish them!
It's an intruder!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安]
哇啊啊啊啊！！！
惩罚他们！
那是入侵者！！！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Oops!
Looks like we got caught?!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
哎呀！
看来我们被发现了？！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Hey!
There are many enemies, so let's scatter and run away!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
嘿！
敌人太多了，我们散开逃跑吧！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Take care of those chasing us appropriately.
Then see you near the exit in a minute!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
好好应付一下追兵。
然后我们在出口附近见！

scripts.text:
- Wait a moment!!
- You have too many items. -
- You can't receive this. -
- Lighten your weight and -
- try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！！
- 您的物品栏已满。 -
- 无法接收此物品。 -
- 请减轻负重后 -
- 再次尝试。 -

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Teddy Bear]
Ah...
Is this a dream or reality...
Am I dead... or am I alive...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的泰迪熊]
啊...
这是梦还是现实...
我是死了...还是活着...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Teddy Bear]
We're... not supposed to come back...
I have to go back...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的泰迪熊]
我们...本不该回来的...
我必须回去...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Teddy Bear]
Whoops...don't rush me like that...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的泰迪熊]
哎呀...别这么急着推我...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Teddy Bear]
Ah...
Is this a dream or reality...
Am I dead... or am I alive...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的泰迪熊]
啊...
这是梦还是现实...
我是死了...还是活着...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Teddy Bear]
We're... not supposed to come back...
I have to go back...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的泰迪熊]
我们...本不该回来的...
我必须回去...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Teddy Bear]
Hey... don't just stand there, help me...
Me... the Nazarians...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的泰迪熊]
嘿...别光站着，帮帮我...
我...纳扎里安...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Teddy Bear]
^ff0000Kill 10 {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, and {4}^000000 and return them to the depths... to rest...
Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Teddy Bear]
...Ah...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的泰迪熊]
...啊...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Teddy Bear]
I want to end this... infernal nightmare...
Come on...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的泰迪熊]
我想结束这个...地狱般的梦魇...
拜托了...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Teddy Bear]
Ah... When will the peaceful rest...
...is the request yet...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的泰迪熊]
啊...何时才能迎来...安宁的休息...
...请求尚未完成...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Teddy Bear]
Ah... When will the peaceful rest...
...is the request yet...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的泰迪熊]
啊...何时才能迎来...安宁的休息...
...请求尚未完成...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Teddy Bear]
Why is it still... not going away...
This horrible nightmare...
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的泰迪熊]
为什么还是...没有消失...
这个可怕的梦魇...

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Porcelain Doll Craftsman]
Kyaaaaaa!!!!!
You were surprised!
scripts.translation:
[瓷娃娃工匠]
呀啊啊啊！！！！
吓到你了吧！

scripts.text:
[Porcelain Doll Craftsman]
Adventurer, welcome back.
Thanks to you, I have been able to continue my studies in the deep parts of the mine.
Please come back again at dawn.
scripts.translation:
[瓷娃娃工匠]
冒险者，欢迎回来。
多亏了你，我才能继续在矿洞深处进行研究。
请在黎明时分再来。

scripts.text:
[Porcelain Doll Craftsman]
Kyaaaaaa!!!!!
You were surprised!
scripts.translation:
[瓷娃娃工匠]
呀啊啊啊！！！！
吓到你了吧！

scripts.text:
[Porcelain Doll Craftsman]
Have you ever seen a huge ^ff0000{0}^000000 nearby?
I barely made it to the entrance, but when I try to leave, he shows up and has been hiding here for days.
scripts.translation:
[瓷娃娃工匠]
你最近有没有看到附近有一只巨大的^ff0000{0}^000000？
我好不容易才走到入口，但每次想离开，它就会出现，已经在这里躲了好几天了。

scripts.text: Help
scripts.translation: 帮助

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Porcelain Doll Craftsman]
Sob!
It's over!!!
I'm stuck here forever!
scripts.translation:
[瓷娃娃工匠]
呜...
完了！！！！
我要永远被困在这里了！

scripts.text:
[Porcelain Doll Craftsman]
Alive!!!
Did you see that?
It's a huge ^ff0000{0}^000000.
You must kill it!
scripts.translation:
[瓷娃娃工匠]
还活着！！！！
你看到了吗？
那是一只巨大的^ff0000{0}^000000。
你必须杀掉它！

scripts.text:
[Porcelain Doll Craftsman]
How are you?
Have you killed ^ff0000{0}^000000?
scripts.translation:
[瓷娃娃工匠]
你好吗？
你杀掉^ff0000{0}^000000了吗？
